decisions.name: Decision 127/PUU-XXI/2023 (fishing crew under the migrant worker protection law)
decisions.q: Should ship crew and fishers be taken out of Law 18/2017 on the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers, as the petition asked?
decisions.q_id: Apakah awak kapal dan pelaut perikanan harus dikeluarkan dari UU 18/2017 tentang Pelindungan Pekerja Migran Indonesia, seperti diminta pemohon?
decisions.held: The Court rejected the petition. Ship crew and fishers working abroad remain migrant workers covered by the protection law (Art. 4(1)(c)).
decisions.plain: Some groups asked the Constitutional Court to remove ship crew and fishers from Indonesia’s law protecting migrant workers. The Court said no. Indonesians who work on foreign fishing and merchant ships stay protected by that law.
decisions.plain_id: Sejumlah pihak meminta Mahkamah Konstitusi mengeluarkan awak kapal dan pelaut perikanan dari UU pelindungan pekerja migran. MK menolak. Warga Indonesia yang bekerja di kapal ikan dan kapal niaga asing tetap dilindungi undang-undang itu.

after.en: Petition registered at the Constitutional Court.

after.id: Permohonan ditolak; Pasal 4 ayat (1) huruf c tetap berlaku.

decisions.name: Serrano v. Gallant Maritime Services
decisions.q: May the law cap the money owed to an illegally dismissed overseas worker at three months’ pay for each year of the unexpired contract?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah undang-undang membatasi ganti rugi bagi pekerja luar negeri yang dipecat secara tidak sah menjadi tiga bulan gaji untuk tiap tahun sisa kontrak?
decisions.held: The cap in Section 10 of Republic Act 8042 was struck down as a breach of equal protection; the worker was owed his salary for the whole unexpired term.
decisions.plain: A Filipino seafarer was sent home before his contract ended. The law limited what he could claim to three months’ pay. The Supreme Court said this limit treated overseas workers unfairly and struck it down, so he could claim pay for the rest of his contract.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pelaut Filipina dipulangkan sebelum kontraknya berakhir. Undang-undang membatasi tuntutannya hanya tiga bulan gaji. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan batas itu tidak adil bagi pekerja luar negeri dan membatalkannya, sehingga ia bisa menuntut gaji sampai akhir kontrak.

after.en: Congress re-enacted the same cap in Republic Act 10022.
after.id: Kongres memasukkan kembali batas yang sama dalam UU 10022.

after.en: Supreme Court struck the re-enacted cap down again (Sameer v. Cabiles).
after.id: MA membatalkan lagi batas itu (Sameer v. Cabiles).

decisions.name: Sameer Overseas Placement Agency v. Cabiles
decisions.q: After Serrano, Congress put the three-month cap back into the law. Is the re-enacted cap valid, and is the Philippine recruiter liable with the foreign employer?
decisions.q_id: Setelah putusan Serrano, Kongres memasukkan kembali batas tiga bulan. Apakah batas itu sah, dan apakah agen perekrut di Filipina ikut bertanggung jawab bersama majikan di luar negeri?
decisions.held: The re-enacted cap is unconstitutional for the same reasons; the worker recovers salary for the unexpired term, and the recruitment agency is jointly liable with the foreign employer.
decisions.plain: A woman recruited in the Philippines for factory work in Taiwan was sent home early. The Supreme Court said the limit on her claim was still unfair, even though Congress had written it into the law again, and that the agency that recruited her must pay together with the employer.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan yang direkrut di Filipina untuk bekerja di pabrik di Taiwan dipulangkan lebih awal. MA menyatakan batas tuntutannya tetap tidak adil, walaupun Kongres sudah menuliskannya lagi dalam undang-undang, dan agen yang merekrutnya wajib membayar bersama majikan.

after.en: [Check whether the cap was removed from the statute.]
after.id: [Periksa apakah batas itu sudah dihapus dari undang-undang.]

decisions.name: Vallejos v. Commissioner of Registration
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: May the Immigration Ordinance exclude foreign domestic helpers from being “ordinarily resident”, so that their years in Hong Kong do not count towards permanent residence?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah UU Imigrasi mengecualikan pekerja rumah tangga asing dari status “biasa bertempat tinggal”, sehingga tahun-tahun mereka di Hong Kong tidak dihitung untuk izin tinggal tetap?
decisions.held: Yes. Given the nature of helpers’ residence (tied to a specific employer and contract, with return expected), the exclusion is consistent with Article 24(2)(4) of the Basic Law.
decisions.plain: A domestic worker from the Philippines had worked in Hong Kong for many years. Most people who live there for seven years can become permanent residents, but the law says time as a foreign domestic helper does not count. The highest court said that rule is allowed.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga dari Filipina sudah bekerja di Hong Kong bertahun-tahun. Kebanyakan orang yang tinggal tujuh tahun di sana bisa menjadi penduduk tetap, tetapi hukum menyatakan masa kerja sebagai pekerja rumah tangga asing tidak dihitung. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan aturan itu boleh.

after.en: Court of First Instance finds the exclusion unconstitutional.
after.id: Pengadilan tingkat pertama menyatakan pengecualian itu inkonstitusional.

after.en: Court of Final Appeal dismisses the appeal. Law unchanged.
after.id: Pengadilan Banding Akhir menolak banding. Hukum tidak berubah.

decisions.name: Lubiano v. Director of Immigration
decisions.q: Is the rule that foreign domestic helpers must live in their employer’s home lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah aturan bahwa pekerja rumah tangga asing wajib tinggal di rumah majikan itu sah?
decisions.held: Yes. The Director of Immigration may impose the live-in condition; the Court of Appeal held it falls within Hong Kong’s reservation to Article 6 of the ICESCR and does not itself force helpers to work on rest days.
decisions.plain: A domestic worker challenged the rule that helpers must live with their employers, saying it leads to very long hours. Both courts said the government may keep the rule.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga menggugat aturan wajib tinggal bersama majikan, karena aturan itu membuat jam kerja sangat panjang. Kedua pengadilan menyatakan pemerintah boleh mempertahankan aturan itu.

after.en: Court of First Instance dismisses the challenge.
Court of Appeal dismisses the appeal. Rule unchanged.
after.id: Pengadilan Banding menolak banding. Aturan tidak berubah.

decisions.name: Seoul-Gyeonggi-Incheon Migrants’ Trade Union v. Minister of Labor
decisions.q: Can migrant workers without a valid stay permit form and join a trade union?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pekerja migran tanpa izin tinggal yang sah membentuk dan bergabung dengan serikat pekerja?
decisions.held: Yes. Anyone who lives on wages from work is a worker under the Trade Union Act, whatever their immigration status; refusing the union’s registration on that ground was unlawful.
decisions.plain: Migrant workers in Korea set up a union, but the government refused to register it because some members had no valid visa. After eight years in court, the Supreme Court said all people who work for wages are workers and may form unions.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja migran di Korea membentuk serikat, tetapi pemerintah menolak mendaftarkannya karena sebagian anggota tidak punya visa yang sah. Setelah delapan tahun di pengadilan, Mahkamah Agung menyatakan semua orang yang bekerja untuk upah adalah pekerja dan boleh membentuk serikat.

after.en: Seoul High Court rules for the union.
Supreme Court rules for the union.
After two further refusals and a sit-in, the ministry registers the union.
after.id: Setelah dua kali ditolak lagi dan aksi duduk, kementerian mendaftarkan serikat.

src.t: Korea Herald: first migrant union authorized

decisions.name: Limits on changing workplace under the Employment Permit System
decisions.q: Does limiting migrant workers to three changes of workplace during their permit breach their freedom to choose an occupation?
decisions.q_id: Apakah membatasi pekerja migran hanya tiga kali pindah tempat kerja selama izinnya melanggar kebebasan memilih pekerjaan?
decisions.held: No. The Court upheld the limit in the Act on Foreign Workers’ Employment.
decisions.plain: Workers who come to Korea under the Employment Permit System can change employer only a few times. They asked the Constitutional Court to remove this limit. The Court kept it.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja yang datang ke Korea lewat Sistem Izin Kerja (EPS) hanya boleh beberapa kali pindah majikan. Mereka meminta MK menghapus batas itu. MK mempertahankannya.

after.en: A new complaint against the system was also rejected (reported).
after.id: Permohonan baru terhadap sistem ini juga ditolak (menurut laporan).

decisions.name: In Re: Problems and Miseries of Migrant Labourers
decisions.cite: Suo Motu Writ Petition (Civil) No. 6 of 2020
decisions.q: What must governments do to secure food and registration for migrant workers stranded or out of work during the pandemic?
decisions.q_id: Apa yang wajib dilakukan pemerintah agar pekerja migran yang terdampar atau kehilangan pekerjaan selama pandemi mendapat pangan dan terdaftar?
decisions.held: The Court directed the central government to build a national database of unorganised workers and every state to implement “One Nation One Ration Card”, with dry rations and community kitchens for migrant workers.
decisions.plain: During COVID-19, millions of workers who had moved within India lost their jobs and could not get food rations away from home. The Supreme Court ordered the government to register them and let them use their ration card anywhere in the country.
decisions.plain_id: Selama COVID-19, jutaan pekerja yang merantau di dalam India kehilangan pekerjaan dan tidak bisa mendapat jatah pangan di luar daerah asal. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah mendaftar mereka dan membolehkan kartu jatah pangan dipakai di seluruh negeri.

after.en: Court takes up the matter on its own motion.
after.id: Pengadilan mengambil perkara atas prakarsa sendiri.

after.en: National database for unorganised workers (e-Shram) launched.
after.id: Basis data nasional pekerja informal (e-Shram) diluncurkan.

after.en: [Check state compliance with the ration card direction.]
after.id: [Periksa kepatuhan negara bagian atas perintah kartu jatah.]

decisions.name: Kav LaOved v. Government of Israel
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: Is the “binding arrangement”, which tied each migrant worker’s permit to one employer, lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah “aturan pengikatan”, yang mengikat izin tiap pekerja migran pada satu majikan, sah?
decisions.held: No. Binding workers to a single employer disproportionately violated their dignity and liberty; the State was ordered to design a new arrangement.
decisions.plain: In Israel, a migrant worker’s permit was tied to one employer. Leaving that employer meant losing legal status. The Supreme Court said this harmed workers’ dignity and freedom and told the government to change it.
decisions.plain_id: Di Israel, izin pekerja migran terikat pada satu majikan. Meninggalkan majikan berarti kehilangan status hukum. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan aturan ini merugikan martabat dan kebebasan pekerja dan memerintahkan pemerintah mengubahnya.

after.id: Aturan dicabut; izin berbasis sektor diperkenalkan (menurut laporan).

after.en: Scholars report that ties to employers persisted in some sectors. [Check.]
after.id: Peneliti melaporkan ikatan pada majikan masih ada di beberapa sektor. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Discovery Health Ltd v. CCMA and Others
decisions.q: Is a foreign worker without a valid work permit an “employee” who can bring an unfair dismissal claim?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pekerja asing tanpa izin kerja yang sah termasuk “pekerja” yang bisa menggugat pemecatan tidak adil?
decisions.held: Yes. The contract is not void merely because the worker lacks a permit, and the Labour Relations Act protects anyone who works for another; the dismissal claim could proceed.
decisions.plain: A foreign worker in South Africa was dismissed after his work permit ran out. The employer said he could not complain because he had no permit. The Labour Court said he was still an employee and could bring his case.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja asing di Afrika Selatan dipecat setelah izin kerjanya habis. Majikan berkata ia tidak bisa menggugat karena tidak punya izin. Pengadilan Ketenagakerjaan menyatakan ia tetap pekerja dan boleh mengajukan perkaranya.

after.en: Labour Court rules the worker is an employee.
[Check the outcome of the dismissal claim and later use of the ruling.]
after.id: [Periksa hasil gugatan pemecatan dan penggunaan putusan ini kemudian.]

decisions.name: Larbi-Odam and Others v. MEC for Education (North-West Province)
decisions.q: May the State bar non-citizens from permanent teaching posts?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara melarang bukan warga negara memegang jabatan guru tetap?
decisions.held: No. Excluding permanent residents from permanent posts was unfair discrimination on the ground of citizenship; the Court read in “or permanent resident”.
decisions.plain: Teachers from other African countries were told they could not hold permanent jobs because they were not South African citizens. The Constitutional Court said this was unfair discrimination and opened the posts to permanent residents.
decisions.plain_id: Guru-guru dari negara Afrika lain diberi tahu bahwa mereka tidak boleh menjadi guru tetap karena bukan warga Afrika Selatan. Mahkamah Konstitusi menyatakan ini diskriminasi yang tidak adil dan membuka jabatan itu bagi penduduk tetap.

after.en: Regulation changed by the Court’s own order (reading-in).
after.id: Peraturan diubah langsung oleh putusan MK.

src.t: Constitutional Court of South Africa, judgment archive
lawlibrary.org.za - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: Chowdury and Others v. Greece
decisions.q: Did Greece protect Bangladeshi strawberry pickers from forced labour and trafficking, and punish those responsible?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Yunani melindungi pemetik stroberi asal Bangladesh dari kerja paksa dan perdagangan orang, serta menghukum pelakunya?
decisions.held: No. The workers were in forced labour; Greece failed to prevent it, protect them and run an effective investigation and prosecution (Article 4(2)).
decisions.plain: Workers from Bangladesh picked strawberries in Greece for months without pay. When they asked for their wages, a supervisor shot at them. A Greek court cleared the employers of trafficking. The European Court said Greece failed to protect the workers from forced labour and ordered compensation.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja dari Bangladesh memetik stroberi di Yunani berbulan-bulan tanpa upah. Saat mereka menagih upah, seorang mandor menembaki mereka. Pengadilan Yunani membebaskan majikan dari dakwaan perdagangan orang. Pengadilan HAM Eropa menyatakan Yunani gagal melindungi para pekerja dari kerja paksa dan memerintahkan ganti rugi.

after.en: Workers shot at after asking for wages.
[Check execution status with the Committee of Ministers.]

decisions.name: Rantsev v. Cyprus and Russia
decisions.q: Did Cyprus and Russia meet their duties towards a young woman recruited for cabaret work on an “artiste” visa who died soon after arriving?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Siprus dan Rusia memenuhi kewajiban terhadap perempuan muda yang direkrut untuk bekerja di kabaret dengan visa “artis” dan meninggal tak lama setelah tiba?
decisions.held: No. Trafficking falls within Article 4; Cyprus lacked an adequate framework and failed to protect her, and Russia failed to investigate her recruitment.
decisions.plain: A young woman from Russia went to Cyprus on a special visa for cabaret work and died soon after. Her father took the case to the European Court. It said both countries failed her: trafficking is covered by the ban on slavery and forced labour, and states must prevent it, protect victims and investigate.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan muda dari Rusia pergi ke Siprus dengan visa khusus untuk bekerja di kabaret dan meninggal tak lama kemudian. Ayahnya membawa perkara ke Pengadilan HAM Eropa. Pengadilan menyatakan kedua negara gagal: perdagangan orang termasuk larangan perbudakan dan kerja paksa, dan negara wajib mencegah, melindungi korban dan menyelidiki.

decisions.name: Siliadin v. France
decisions.q: Did French criminal law protect a teenage domestic worker from servitude and forced labour?
decisions.q_id: Apakah hukum pidana Prancis melindungi pekerja rumah tangga remaja dari perhambaan dan kerja paksa?
decisions.held: No. Article 4 requires states to make servitude and forced labour criminal offences and enforce them; the law then in force did not give practical and effective protection.
decisions.plain: A teenager from Togo was made to work in a home in Paris for years without pay or rest. The European Court said France broke the Convention because its criminal law did not properly punish servitude. France changed its law.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang remaja dari Togo dipaksa bekerja di sebuah rumah di Paris bertahun-tahun tanpa upah dan istirahat. Pengadilan HAM Eropa menyatakan Prancis melanggar Konvensi karena hukum pidananya tidak cukup menghukum perhambaan. Prancis mengubah undang-undangnya.

after.en: Law 2013-711 adds offences of slavery, servitude and forced labour.
after.id: UU 2013-711 menambah tindak pidana perbudakan, perhambaan dan kerja paksa.

decisions.name: C.N. v. the United Kingdom
decisions.q: Could UK police investigate a complaint of domestic servitude when there was no specific offence of servitude?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah polisi Inggris menyelidiki pengaduan perhambaan rumah tangga jika belum ada tindak pidana perhambaan?
decisions.held: No. Without a specific offence the investigation could not be effective; violation of Article 4.
decisions.plain: A woman from Uganda said she was kept as a domestic servant in London. The police could not deal with it properly because servitude was not a crime in itself. The European Court said the UK broke the Convention. The UK had created that crime in 2010.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Uganda mengaku ditahan sebagai pembantu di London. Polisi tidak bisa menanganinya dengan benar karena perhambaan belum menjadi tindak pidana tersendiri. Pengadilan HAM Eropa menyatakan Inggris melanggar Konvensi. Inggris sudah membuat tindak pidana itu pada 2010.

after.en: Coroners and Justice Act 2009, s. 71 in force.

decisions.name: Hounga v. Allen
decisions.court: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom
decisions.q: Does working illegally bar a trafficked domestic worker from claiming discrimination in her dismissal?
decisions.q_id: Apakah bekerja secara ilegal menghalangi pekerja rumah tangga korban perdagangan orang untuk menggugat diskriminasi atas pemecatannya?
decisions.held: No. Public policy against trafficking and in favour of protecting its victims outweighs the illegality defence.
decisions.plain: A young woman from Nigeria was brought to the UK on false papers to work in a family home, abused and then thrown out. The employer said she could not sue because her work was illegal. The Supreme Court said she could.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan muda dari Nigeria dibawa ke Inggris dengan dokumen palsu untuk bekerja di rumah keluarga, dianiaya lalu diusir. Majikan berkata ia tidak bisa menggugat karena pekerjaannya ilegal. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan ia boleh menggugat.

after.en: Tribunal award for discriminatory dismissal restored.
after.id: Putusan ganti rugi atas pemecatan diskriminatif dipulihkan.

decisions.name: Taiwo v. Olaigbe; Onu v. Akwiwu
decisions.court: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom
decisions.q: Is mistreating a worker because her immigration status makes her vulnerable discrimination on grounds of race or nationality?
decisions.q_id: Apakah memperlakukan pekerja secara buruk karena status imigrasinya membuatnya rentan termasuk diskriminasi berdasarkan ras atau kewarganegaraan?
decisions.held: No. Immigration status is not nationality; the discrimination claims failed, although the workers had other remedies.
decisions.plain: Two domestic workers from Nigeria were badly treated by employers who knew their visas left them with nowhere to go. They said this was race discrimination. The Supreme Court disagreed: immigration status is not race or nationality under the law.
decisions.plain_id: Dua pekerja rumah tangga dari Nigeria diperlakukan buruk oleh majikan yang tahu visa mereka membuat mereka tidak punya pilihan. Mereka menyebutnya diskriminasi ras. MA tidak setuju: menurut hukum, status imigrasi bukan ras atau kewarganegaraan.

after.en: Claims dismissed; the Court noted that Parliament could address the gap. Law unchanged.
after.id: Gugatan ditolak; pengadilan mencatat parlemen dapat menutup celah ini. Hukum tidak berubah.

decisions.name: Hoffman Plastic Compounds, Inc. v. NLRB
decisions.court: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.q: Can the labor board award back pay to an undocumented worker dismissed for union activity?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah dewan perburuhan memberikan upah tertunggak kepada pekerja tanpa dokumen yang dipecat karena kegiatan serikat?
decisions.held: No (5–4). Back pay for work not performed would conflict with federal immigration policy; other remedies remain.
decisions.plain: A worker in the United States lost his job for supporting a union. Because he had no permission to work, the Supreme Court said he could not get the wages he would have earned, even though the employer broke the law.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja di Amerika Serikat dipecat karena mendukung serikat. Karena ia tidak punya izin kerja, MA menyatakan ia tidak bisa mendapat upah yang seharusnya ia peroleh, walaupun majikan melanggar hukum.

after.en: Back pay award set aside. Law unchanged.
after.id: Putusan upah tertunggak dibatalkan. Hukum tidak berubah.

decisions.name: Juridical Condition and Rights of Undocumented Migrants (Advisory Opinion OC-18/03)
decisions.q: May a state deny migrant workers labour rights because they lack immigration status?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara menolak hak-hak pekerja bagi pekerja migran karena mereka tidak punya status imigrasi?
decisions.held: No. Equality and non-discrimination are peremptory norms; once employed, a migrant holds the labour rights of a worker whatever their status.
decisions.plain: Mexico asked the Inter-American Court whether countries may deny labour rights to migrants without papers. The Court said no: once someone works, they have the same labour rights as other workers.
decisions.plain_id: Meksiko bertanya kepada Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika apakah negara boleh menolak hak pekerja bagi migran tanpa dokumen. Pengadilan menjawab tidak: begitu seseorang bekerja, ia punya hak pekerja yang sama dengan pekerja lain.

decisions.name: Avena and Other Mexican Nationals (Mexico v. United States of America)
decisions.q: Did the United States breach the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations by not telling arrested Mexican nationals they could contact their consulate?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Amerika Serikat melanggar Konvensi Wina tentang Hubungan Konsuler karena tidak memberi tahu warga Meksiko yang ditangkap bahwa mereka boleh menghubungi konsulatnya?
decisions.held: Yes. The US breached Article 36 for Mexican nationals sentenced to death and must provide review and reconsideration of their convictions and sentences.
decisions.plain: Mexican nationals arrested in the United States were not told they could call their consulate. The World Court said the US broke international law and must review their cases. Many were never reviewed.
decisions.plain_id: Warga Meksiko yang ditangkap di Amerika Serikat tidak diberi tahu bahwa mereka boleh menghubungi konsulat. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan AS melanggar hukum internasional dan wajib meninjau ulang perkara mereka. Banyak perkara tidak pernah ditinjau.

after.en: US Supreme Court (Medellín v. Texas) holds the judgment not directly enforceable in US courts.
after.id: MA AS (Medellín v. Texas) menyatakan putusan itu tidak langsung berlaku di pengadilan AS.

after.en: Several of the nationals were executed without review.
after.id: Beberapa warga itu dieksekusi tanpa peninjauan.

decisions.name: Case No. 2121 (Spain): trade union rights of migrants without residence
decisions.court: ILO Committee on Freedom of Association
decisions.cite: Case No. 2121 [report number to be added]
decisions.q: May a law make the right to join a union depend on the worker having legal residence?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah undang-undang mensyaratkan izin tinggal yang sah untuk hak bergabung dengan serikat pekerja?
decisions.held: No. Freedom of association belongs to all workers without distinction, including those in an irregular situation; the Committee asked Spain to amend its Aliens Act.
decisions.plain: A Spanish law said migrants without legal residence could not join unions. The ILO’s freedom of association committee said every worker, with or without papers, may join a union, and asked Spain to change the law. Spain’s Constitutional Court later struck the rule down.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah UU Spanyol menyatakan migran tanpa izin tinggal tidak boleh bergabung dengan serikat. Komite Kebebasan Berserikat ILO menyatakan setiap pekerja, berdokumen atau tidak, boleh bergabung dengan serikat, dan meminta Spanyol mengubah UU itu. MK Spanyol kemudian membatalkan aturan tersebut.

after.en: Spanish Constitutional Court strikes down the residence requirement (STC 236/2007).
after.id: MK Spanyol membatalkan syarat izin tinggal (STC 236/2007).

decisions.name: Vélez Loor v. Panama
decisions.q: May a state punish irregular migration with prison, and in what conditions may migrants be detained?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara menghukum migrasi tidak teratur dengan penjara, dan dalam kondisi apa migran boleh ditahan?
decisions.held: Prison sentences to punish irregular migration are incompatible with the American Convention; migrants may be detained only when necessary and proportionate, apart from people held for crimes, with access to consular assistance.
decisions.plain: A man from Ecuador was arrested in Panama for entering without papers, sent to prison and mistreated. The Inter-American Court said countries may not jail people just for migrating irregularly, and that detained migrants must be kept apart from prisoners and allowed to contact their consulate.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria dari Ekuador ditangkap di Panama karena masuk tanpa dokumen, dipenjara dan dianiaya. Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan negara tidak boleh memenjarakan orang hanya karena bermigrasi tanpa dokumen, dan migran yang ditahan harus dipisahkan dari narapidana serta boleh menghubungi konsulatnya.

after.en: Court’s compliance review: medical-care payment made, other measures pending.
after.id: Tinjauan kepatuhan: biaya perawatan dibayar, langkah lain belum.

decisions.name: Nadège Dorzema et al. v. Dominican Republic
decisions.q: Was the State responsible for soldiers’ use of force against a truck carrying Haitian migrants, and for expelling the survivors?
decisions.q_id: Apakah negara bertanggung jawab atas penggunaan kekerasan oleh tentara terhadap truk yang membawa migran Haiti, dan atas pengusiran para korban yang selamat?
decisions.held: Yes. The force was excessive, the survivors were expelled collectively without individual assessment, and the acts took place in a context of discrimination against Haitians.
decisions.plain: Soldiers fired on a truck carrying Haitian migrants near the border, killing seven people. Survivors were sent back to Haiti without any hearing. The Inter-American Court said the Dominican Republic violated their rights and must not expel migrants as a group.
decisions.plain_id: Tentara menembaki truk yang membawa migran Haiti di dekat perbatasan, menewaskan tujuh orang. Korban selamat dipulangkan ke Haiti tanpa pemeriksaan. Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan Republik Dominika melanggar hak mereka dan tidak boleh mengusir migran secara berkelompok.

decisions.name: Yean and Bosico Girls v. Dominican Republic
decisions.q: Could the State refuse to register the births of two girls born in the Dominican Republic to families of Haitian descent?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara menolak mencatat kelahiran dua anak perempuan yang lahir di Republik Dominika dari keluarga keturunan Haiti?
decisions.held: No. The refusal was discriminatory and left the girls stateless; a parent’s migratory status cannot be passed on to children.
decisions.plain: Two girls born in the Dominican Republic to families of Haitian descent were refused birth certificates, leaving them without any nationality. The Inter-American Court said this was discrimination and that children do not inherit their parents’ migration status.
decisions.plain_id: Dua anak perempuan yang lahir di Republik Dominika dari keluarga keturunan Haiti ditolak akta kelahirannya, sehingga tidak punya kewarganegaraan. Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan ini diskriminasi dan anak tidak mewarisi status migrasi orang tuanya.

after.en: Dominican Constitutional Court rules the other way for a wider group (TC/0168/13).
after.id: MK Dominika memutus sebaliknya untuk kelompok yang lebih luas (TC/0168/13).

decisions.name: Sentencia TC/0168/13 (nationality of children of foreign residents)
decisions.court: Constitutional Tribunal of the Dominican Republic
decisions.q: Is a person born in the Dominican Republic to parents without regular status a Dominican national?
decisions.q_id: Apakah orang yang lahir di Republik Dominika dari orang tua tanpa status tetap adalah warga negara Dominika?
decisions.held: No. Children of foreigners “in transit”, read to include irregular migrants, are excluded, applied back to 1929; the authorities were ordered to audit civil registries.
decisions.plain: A woman born in the Dominican Republic to Haitian parents was refused her identity card. The Constitutional Tribunal said children of migrants without papers were never Dominican, going back to 1929. Tens of thousands of people, mostly of Haitian descent, risked losing their nationality.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan yang lahir di Republik Dominika dari orang tua Haiti ditolak kartu identitasnya. MK menyatakan anak migran tanpa dokumen tidak pernah menjadi warga Dominika, berlaku surut sampai 1929. Puluhan ribu orang, kebanyakan keturunan Haiti, terancam kehilangan kewarganegaraan.

after.en: Law 169-14 offers a partial route back to documents.
after.id: UU 169-14 memberi jalan sebagian untuk memperoleh dokumen.

after.en: Inter-American Court finds the approach in breach of the Convention (Expelled Dominicans and Haitians).
after.id: Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan pendekatan ini melanggar Konvensi.

after.en: Constitutional Tribunal declares the country’s acceptance of the Inter-American Court’s jurisdiction invalid (TC/0256/14).
after.id: MK menyatakan penerimaan yurisdiksi Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika tidak sah (TC/0256/14).

decisions.name: Expelled Dominicans and Haitians v. Dominican Republic
decisions.q: Did the Dominican Republic violate the rights of Haitians and Dominicans of Haitian descent through summary expulsions and the denial of nationality?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Republik Dominika melanggar hak warga Haiti dan warga Dominika keturunan Haiti melalui pengusiran kilat dan penolakan kewarganegaraan?
decisions.held: Yes. The expulsions were arbitrary and collective, and TC/0168/13 and Law 169-14 breached the right to nationality and equality; the State was ordered to leave them without effect.
decisions.plain: People of Haitian descent, many born in the Dominican Republic, were rounded up and sent to Haiti. The Inter-American Court said this broke their rights and that the 2013 nationality ruling must be undone. The Dominican Republic refused and rejected the Court’s authority.
decisions.plain_id: Orang keturunan Haiti, banyak yang lahir di Republik Dominika, ditangkap dan dikirim ke Haiti. Pengadilan HAM Antar-Amerika menyatakan ini melanggar hak mereka dan putusan kewarganegaraan 2013 harus dibatalkan. Republik Dominika menolak dan tidak mengakui kewenangan Pengadilan.

after.en: Constitutional Tribunal rejects the Court’s jurisdiction (TC/0256/14).

decisions.name: Reyes Aguilera, Daniela c/ Estado Nacional
decisions.q: May a disability pension be denied to a foreign resident because she has not lived in Argentina for 20 years?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pensiun disabilitas ditolak bagi penduduk asing karena ia belum tinggal 20 tahun di Argentina?
decisions.held: No. The 20-year residence requirement in Decree 432/97 was declared unconstitutional in her case.
decisions.plain: A girl from Bolivia with a severe disability had lived in Argentina since 1999. She was refused a disability pension because foreigners needed 20 years of residence. The Supreme Court said that rule was unconstitutional.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang anak perempuan dari Bolivia dengan disabilitas berat tinggal di Argentina sejak 1999. Ia ditolak pensiun disabilitas karena orang asing harus tinggal 20 tahun. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan aturan itu inkonstitusional.

after.en: Lower courts follow the ruling in similar cases.
after.id: Pengadilan di bawahnya mengikuti putusan ini dalam kasus serupa.

decisions.name: Sentencia SU-677/17 (emergency health care for migrants without status)
decisions.q: Must Colombia provide health care to Venezuelan migrants who have no regular status?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Kolombia wajib memberi layanan kesehatan kepada migran Venezuela yang tidak punya status tetap?
decisions.held: Yes, at least emergency care, read broadly in light of the right to a dignified life; full enrolment in the health system generally requires regularising status.
decisions.plain: A pregnant woman from Venezuela without legal status in Colombia was refused prenatal care. The Constitutional Court said everyone, with or without papers, has a right to urgent health care, understood broadly.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan hamil dari Venezuela tanpa status hukum di Kolombia ditolak layanan kehamilan. MK menyatakan setiap orang, berdokumen atau tidak, berhak atas layanan kesehatan darurat yang dipahami secara luas.

after.en: Followed in later rulings such as T-074/19 and T-296/22.
after.id: Diikuti dalam putusan berikutnya seperti T-074/19 dan T-296/22.

decisions.name: Order to use the Foreign Employment Welfare Fund for repatriation
decisions.q: Must the government pay to bring home Nepali workers stranded abroad during the pandemic who cannot afford the airfare?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pemerintah wajib membiayai pemulangan pekerja Nepal yang terdampar di luar negeri selama pandemi dan tidak mampu membeli tiket?
decisions.held: Yes. Making stranded workers pay their own way home was contrary to sections 32, 33 and 74 of the Foreign Employment Act 2007; the Welfare Fund, built from workers’ own contributions, must be used to repatriate those in vulnerable situations.
decisions.plain: During COVID-19, many Nepali workers lost their jobs abroad and could not pay for a flight home. The Supreme Court ordered the government to use the welfare fund that workers pay into to bring them back.
decisions.plain_id: Selama COVID-19, banyak pekerja Nepal kehilangan pekerjaan di luar negeri dan tidak mampu membeli tiket pulang. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah memakai dana kesejahteraan yang dibayar para pekerja untuk memulangkan mereka.

after.en: Labour attaché posts filled; ordered shelters in destination countries not set up (reported).
after.id: Jabatan atase ketenagakerjaan diisi; rumah aman yang diperintahkan belum dibangun (menurut laporan).

decisions.name: Directive to enforce the “free visa, free ticket” policy
decisions.q: Must the government enforce its own policy that employers in the main destination countries pay workers’ visa and air ticket costs?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pemerintah wajib menegakkan kebijakannya sendiri bahwa majikan di negara tujuan utama menanggung biaya visa dan tiket pekerja?
decisions.held: Yes. A division bench directed the government to take the measures needed to implement the policy effectively.
decisions.plain: Nepal decided in 2015 that employers abroad should pay for workers’ visas and tickets, but agencies kept charging workers. The Supreme Court told the government to make the rule work.
decisions.plain_id: Nepal memutuskan pada 2015 bahwa majikan di luar negeri harus menanggung visa dan tiket pekerja, tetapi agen tetap menarik biaya dari pekerja. Mahkamah Agung memerintahkan pemerintah agar aturan itu benar-benar dijalankan.

after.en: Free visa, free ticket policy adopted.
after.id: Kebijakan visa dan tiket gratis ditetapkan.

after.en: Reports say the policy is still poorly enforced. [Check.]
after.id: Laporan menyebut kebijakan ini masih lemah penegakannya. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Challenge to the rule on women’s migration for domestic work (husband’s consent)
decisions.cite: Fundamental rights petition [number to be added]
decisions.q: Does a rule that lets women go abroad as domestic workers only with family approval breach the constitutional right to equality?
decisions.q_id: Apakah aturan yang hanya membolehkan perempuan bekerja sebagai pekerja rumah tangga di luar negeri dengan persetujuan keluarga melanggar hak konstitusional atas kesetaraan?
decisions.held: The Court refused leave to proceed, finding the rule neither discriminatory nor a violation of fundamental rights.
decisions.plain: Sri Lanka required women who wanted to work abroad as domestic workers to get their family’s approval. A woman said this was unequal treatment. The Supreme Court did not let the case go ahead. The government later dropped the requirement itself.
decisions.plain_id: Sri Lanka mewajibkan perempuan yang ingin bekerja di luar negeri sebagai pekerja rumah tangga mendapat persetujuan keluarga. Seorang perempuan menyebutnya perlakuan tidak setara. Mahkamah Agung tidak melanjutkan perkara itu. Pemerintah kemudian menghapus syarat itu sendiri.

after.en: Family Background Report made compulsory for women going abroad as domestic workers.
after.id: Laporan Latar Belakang Keluarga diwajibkan bagi perempuan yang akan bekerja sebagai PRT di luar negeri.

after.en: Cabinet removes the mandatory report (policy change, not court-ordered).
after.id: Kabinet menghapus kewajiban laporan itu (perubahan kebijakan, bukan perintah pengadilan).

src.t: Daily FT on the 2022 Cabinet decision

decisions.name: Fice Fransina Nenobais v. Lee Hee Chooi
decisions.q: Can an undocumented domestic worker bring a claim for unpaid wages before the Labour Court?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pekerja rumah tangga tanpa dokumen mengajukan tuntutan upah yang tidak dibayar ke Pengadilan Ketenagakerjaan?
decisions.held: Yes. The Court of Appeal upheld the High Court: lacking valid immigration status does not bar a worker from seeking redress at the Labour Court.
decisions.plain: An Indonesian domestic worker in Malaysia went unpaid for almost five years. The labour office refused her claim because she had no valid permit. The courts said she could still claim her wages.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia di Malaysia tidak digaji hampir lima tahun. Kantor ketenagakerjaan menolak tuntutannya karena ia tidak punya izin yang sah. Pengadilan menyatakan ia tetap boleh menuntut upahnya.

after.en: High Court rules she may claim.
after.id: Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ia boleh menuntut.

decisions.name: Parti Liyani v. Public Prosecutor
decisions.q: Should the conviction for theft of a domestic worker, accused by her former employer’s family after her dismissal, stand?
decisions.q_id: Apakah vonis pencurian terhadap pekerja rumah tangga, yang dituduh keluarga mantan majikan setelah ia dipecat, harus dipertahankan?
decisions.held: No. The prosecution had not proved any charge beyond reasonable doubt; the judge also found the family may have had an improper motive in reporting her.
decisions.plain: An Indonesian domestic worker was accused of theft by her employer’s family soon after she was dismissed, and was convicted. On appeal the High Court cleared her completely and said the accusers may have had an improper motive.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dituduh mencuri oleh keluarga majikan tak lama setelah dipecat, lalu divonis bersalah. Di tingkat banding, Pengadilan Tinggi membebaskannya sepenuhnya dan menyatakan para penuduh mungkin punya motif tidak patut.

after.id: Divonis bersalah di pengadilan tingkat pertama.

after.en: Investigation of a family member for false evidence. [Check outcome.]
after.id: Penyelidikan atas anggota keluarga karena keterangan palsu. [Periksa hasilnya.]

decisions.name: Thammakaset Co. v. Department of Labour Protection and Welfare (14 Myanmar workers)
decisions.q: Must a poultry farm pay the compensation ordered by labour inspectors to 14 Myanmar workers for unpaid wages and overtime?
decisions.q_id: Apakah peternakan ayam wajib membayar ganti rugi yang diperintahkan pengawas ketenagakerjaan kepada 14 pekerja Myanmar atas upah dan lembur yang tidak dibayar?
decisions.held: Yes. The Supreme Court upheld the lower court and ordered immediate payment of 1.7 million baht.
decisions.plain: Fourteen workers from Myanmar on a chicken farm in Thailand complained of very long hours, low pay and documents kept by the employer. Labour inspectors ordered compensation. The Supreme Court made the farm pay. The employer also sued workers and advocates for defamation.
decisions.plain_id: Empat belas pekerja dari Myanmar di sebuah peternakan ayam di Thailand mengadukan jam kerja sangat panjang, upah rendah dan dokumen yang ditahan majikan. Pengawas ketenagakerjaan memerintahkan ganti rugi. Mahkamah Agung mewajibkan peternakan membayar. Majikan juga menggugat pekerja dan pendamping dengan tuduhan pencemaran nama baik.

after.en: Lopburi labour office orders compensation; lower court upholds.
after.id: Kantor ketenagakerjaan Lopburi memerintahkan ganti rugi; pengadilan di bawahnya menguatkan.

after.en: Payment confirmed by the Central Labour Court.
Defamation cases brought by the farm against a worker and an advocate end in acquittal. [Check dates.]
after.id: Perkara pencemaran nama baik dari peternakan terhadap pekerja dan pendamping berakhir bebas. [Periksa tanggal.]

decisions.name: Public Prosecutor v. Manas Kongpaen and others (southern trafficking camps)
decisions.q: Were the officials and others charged over jungle camps where Rohingya and Bangladeshi migrants were held for ransom guilty of trafficking?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pejabat dan pihak lain yang didakwa atas kamp hutan tempat migran Rohingya dan Bangladesh ditahan untuk tebusan bersalah atas perdagangan orang?
decisions.held: Yes for 62 of about 102 defendants, including a former army general sentenced to 27 years.
decisions.plain: In 2015 mass graves of migrants were found in camps near the Thai–Malaysian border. A Bangkok court convicted 62 people, including a senior army officer, of trafficking. An appeal court later increased his sentence.
decisions.plain_id: Pada 2015 ditemukan kuburan massal migran di kamp dekat perbatasan Thailand–Malaysia. Pengadilan di Bangkok memvonis 62 orang, termasuk seorang perwira tinggi tentara, atas perdagangan orang. Pengadilan banding kemudian memperberat hukumannya.

after.en: Appeal court upholds and increases the general’s sentence.
after.id: Pengadilan banding menguatkan dan memperberat hukuman sang jenderal.

decisions.name: Domestic worker leaving before the end of her contract
decisions.q: Can a domestic worker be made to stay until her two-year contract ends?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah pekerja rumah tangga dipaksa bertahan sampai kontrak dua tahunnya berakhir?
decisions.held: No, as reported: the court rejected the employer’s case against a worker who left early. Reports differ on whether the employer may claim compensation.
decisions.plain: An employer in Kuwait took a domestic worker to court for leaving before her two-year contract ended. The court rejected the case. Reports say a worker cannot be forced to stay.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang majikan di Kuwait menggugat pekerja rumah tangga yang berhenti sebelum kontrak dua tahunnya selesai. Pengadilan menolak gugatan itu. Menurut laporan, pekerja tidak bisa dipaksa bertahan.

decisions.name: J.Y. Interpretation No. 708 (detention of foreigners pending deportation)
decisions.q: May immigration authorities hold a foreigner awaiting deportation without prompt review by a court?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah otoritas imigrasi menahan orang asing yang menunggu deportasi tanpa segera ditinjau pengadilan?
decisions.held: No. Detention beyond the time needed to arrange removal requires a prompt and effective judicial remedy; the provision was to be amended within two years.
decisions.plain: Taiwan held foreigners, including migrant workers who had left their employers, in detention before deportation without a judge checking. The Constitutional Court said a court must be able to review such detention quickly.
decisions.plain_id: Taiwan menahan orang asing, termasuk pekerja migran yang meninggalkan majikan, sebelum dideportasi tanpa pemeriksaan hakim. MK menyatakan pengadilan harus bisa segera meninjau penahanan itu.

after.en: Immigration Act amended to add court review of detention. [Check date.]
after.id: UU Imigrasi diubah untuk menambah peninjauan pengadilan. [Periksa tanggal.]

decisions.name: J.Y. Interpretation No. 710 (deportation and detention of mainland Chinese residents)
decisions.q: Do people from mainland China facing removal from Taiwan have the same due-process protections as other foreigners?
decisions.q_id: Apakah warga Tiongkok daratan yang akan dikeluarkan dari Taiwan mendapat perlindungan proses hukum yang sama dengan orang asing lain?
decisions.held: Yes. Removal must allow a chance to be heard, and detention pending removal must be limited and subject to prompt judicial review.
decisions.plain: Following its decision on foreigners, the Constitutional Court said people from mainland China must also get a hearing before removal and a quick court check on any detention.
decisions.plain_id: Mengikuti putusan tentang orang asing, MK menyatakan warga Tiongkok daratan juga harus didengar sebelum dikeluarkan dan penahanannya segera diperiksa pengadilan.

decisions.name: J.Y. Interpretation No. 560 (funeral allowance for foreign workers’ family members)
decisions.q: May labour insurance deny a funeral allowance to a foreign worker whose family member died outside Taiwan?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah asuransi tenaga kerja menolak tunjangan pemakaman bagi pekerja asing yang anggota keluarganya meninggal di luar Taiwan?
decisions.held: The exclusion was held consistent with the Constitution. [Check reasoning.]
decisions.plain: A foreign worker in Taiwan asked for the funeral allowance that Taiwanese workers get when a family member dies. The rules excluded family who lived abroad. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja asing di Taiwan meminta tunjangan pemakaman yang didapat pekerja Taiwan saat anggota keluarga meninggal. Aturan mengecualikan keluarga yang tinggal di luar negeri. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.name: McLean v. Minister of Justice
decisions.q: May the Minister refuse to renew a foreign worker’s stay because of his lawful political activity?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah Menteri menolak memperpanjang izin tinggal pekerja asing karena kegiatan politiknya yang sah?
decisions.held: Yes. Constitutional rights extend to foreigners, but within the framework of the residence system; the Minister has broad discretion over renewals.
decisions.plain: A US English teacher in Japan joined peaceful protests. Japan refused to renew his visa. The Supreme Court said foreigners have constitutional rights, but the government has wide freedom to decide on visas.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang guru bahasa Inggris dari AS di Jepang ikut unjuk rasa damai. Jepang menolak memperpanjang visanya. MA menyatakan orang asing punya hak konstitusional, tetapi pemerintah punya keleluasaan luas atas visa.

decisions.name: Chong Hyang Gyun v. Tokyo Metropolitan Government
decisions.q: May Tokyo bar a permanent resident of Korean nationality from the exam for management posts?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah Tokyo melarang penduduk tetap berkewarganegaraan Korea mengikuti ujian jabatan manajerial?
decisions.held: Yes. Reserving posts that involve exercising public authority to nationals does not breach equality.
decisions.plain: A Korean nurse born and working in Japan was not allowed to sit Tokyo’s promotion exam because she was not a citizen. The Supreme Court said this was allowed.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perawat keturunan Korea yang lahir dan bekerja di Jepang tidak diizinkan mengikuti ujian promosi di Tokyo karena bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan hal itu boleh.

decisions.name: Permanent residents and public assistance
decisions.q: Do foreign permanent residents have a legal right to public assistance under the Public Assistance Act?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penduduk tetap asing punya hak hukum atas bantuan sosial menurut UU Bantuan Publik?
decisions.held: No. The Act covers Japanese nationals; foreigners receive assistance only as an administrative measure, not as a legal entitlement.
decisions.plain: An elderly Chinese woman who had lived in Japan for decades was refused welfare. The Supreme Court said foreigners have no legal right to welfare, though the government may give it voluntarily.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan lanjut usia asal Tiongkok yang tinggal puluhan tahun di Jepang ditolak bantuan sosial. MA menyatakan orang asing tidak punya hak hukum atas bantuan sosial, walau pemerintah boleh memberinya secara sukarela.

decisions.name: Nationality Act Article 3 case
decisions.q: May children born outside marriage to a Japanese father and a foreign mother be denied nationality unless the parents marry?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah anak yang lahir di luar nikah dari ayah Jepang dan ibu asing ditolak kewarganegaraannya kecuali orang tuanya menikah?
decisions.held: No. The marriage requirement in Article 3(1) breached equality under Article 14 of the Constitution.
decisions.plain: Children of Filipina mothers and Japanese fathers who were not married could not get Japanese nationality. The Supreme Court said this was unequal. The law was changed the same year.
decisions.plain_id: Anak-anak dari ibu Filipina dan ayah Jepang yang tidak menikah tidak bisa mendapat kewarganegaraan Jepang. MA menyatakan ini tidak setara. UU diubah pada tahun yang sama.

decisions.name: Le Thi Thuy Linh case (technical intern acquitted)
decisions.q: Was a Vietnamese technical intern who gave birth alone to stillborn twins guilty of abandoning their bodies?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pekerja magang asal Vietnam yang melahirkan sendiri bayi kembar yang meninggal bersalah menelantarkan jenazah?
decisions.held: No. Her conduct did not amount to abandonment; the conviction was quashed.
decisions.plain: A young Vietnamese woman working on a farm in Japan hid her pregnancy because she feared being sent home. Her twins were stillborn and she was convicted of abandoning their bodies. The Supreme Court acquitted her.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan muda Vietnam yang bekerja di pertanian di Jepang menyembunyikan kehamilannya karena takut dipulangkan. Bayi kembarnya lahir meninggal dan ia divonis menelantarkan jenazah. MA membebaskannya.

decisions.name: Local voting rights of permanent residents
decisions.q: Does the Constitution guarantee foreign permanent residents the vote in local elections?
decisions.q_id: Apakah konstitusi menjamin hak pilih penduduk tetap asing dalam pemilihan daerah?
decisions.held: No, but the Constitution does not forbid Parliament from granting it.
decisions.plain: Korean permanent residents asked to vote in local elections. The Supreme Court said the Constitution does not give them that right, but Parliament could give it by law.
decisions.plain_id: Penduduk tetap keturunan Korea meminta hak memilih dalam pemilihan daerah. MA menyatakan konstitusi tidak memberi hak itu, tetapi parlemen boleh memberikannya lewat UU.

decisions.name: Lost earnings of an injured worker without a visa
decisions.q: How should damages for lost earnings be calculated for an injured foreign worker who was in Japan without status?
decisions.q_id: Bagaimana ganti rugi kehilangan penghasilan dihitung bagi pekerja asing tanpa izin yang terluka?
decisions.held: On Japanese wages for the period he could expect to stay, then on wages in his home country.
decisions.plain: A Pakistani worker without a visa was injured in a Japanese factory. The Supreme Court said the employer must pay damages, counting Japanese wages for a limited time and home-country wages after that.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja Pakistan tanpa visa terluka di pabrik di Jepang. MA menyatakan majikan wajib membayar ganti rugi, menghitung upah Jepang untuk jangka terbatas lalu upah negara asal sesudahnya.

decisions.name: Industrial trainees and the Labor Standards Act
decisions.q: May foreign “industrial trainees” who do the work of employees be denied key protections of the Labor Standards Act?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah “peserta magang industri” asing yang melakukan pekerjaan karyawan ditolak perlindungan utama UU Standar Ketenagakerjaan?
decisions.held: No. Excluding them from protections such as paid leave and overtime pay breached equality.
decisions.plain: Korea brought in foreign workers as “trainees” who worked like employees but without full labour rights. The Constitutional Court said this was unequal treatment.
decisions.plain_id: Korea mendatangkan pekerja asing sebagai “peserta magang” yang bekerja seperti karyawan tetapi tanpa hak penuh. MK menyatakan ini perlakuan tidak setara.

after.en: Trainee scheme folded into the Employment Permit System.
after.id: Skema magang digabung ke Sistem Izin Kerja.

decisions.name: Severance pay paid only after departure
decisions.q: May the law make migrant workers wait until they leave Korea to receive their departure guarantee insurance (severance)?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah UU membuat pekerja migran menunggu sampai meninggalkan Korea untuk menerima asuransi jaminan keberangkatan (pesangon)?
decisions.held: Yes. The Court found the rule, meant to discourage overstaying, constitutional.
decisions.plain: Korea pays migrant workers’ severance only once they leave the country. Workers said this was unfair. The Constitutional Court kept the rule.
decisions.plain_id: Korea membayar pesangon pekerja migran hanya setelah mereka meninggalkan negara itu. Pekerja menyebutnya tidak adil. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.name: Limits on changing workplace (second challenge)
decisions.q: Do the Employment Permit System’s limits on changing workplace breach migrant workers’ freedom of occupation?
decisions.q_id: Apakah batas pindah tempat kerja dalam Sistem Izin Kerja melanggar kebebasan memilih pekerjaan?
decisions.held: No. The Court again upheld the limits.
decisions.plain: Ten years after the first ruling, migrant workers again challenged the limits on changing employer. The Constitutional Court again kept them.
decisions.plain_id: Sepuluh tahun setelah putusan pertama, pekerja migran kembali menggugat batas pindah majikan. MK kembali mempertahankannya.

decisions.name: Indefinite immigration detention
decisions.q: Is detention of foreigners under the Immigration Act without any upper time limit constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penahanan orang asing menurut UU Imigrasi tanpa batas waktu konstitusional?
decisions.held: No. The provision was found incompatible with the Constitution for lacking a time limit and independent review; Parliament was given until May 2025 to amend it.
decisions.plain: Korea could keep foreigners in immigration detention with no time limit. The Constitutional Court said this was unconstitutional and told Parliament to fix the law.
decisions.plain_id: Korea bisa menahan orang asing di detensi imigrasi tanpa batas waktu. MK menyatakan ini inkonstitusional dan meminta parlemen memperbaiki UU.

decisions.name: Exclusion of farm workers from working-hours rules
decisions.q: Does excluding agricultural workers from the Labor Standards Act’s rules on hours, breaks and rest days breach their rights?
decisions.q_id: Apakah mengecualikan pekerja pertanian dari aturan jam kerja, istirahat dan hari libur melanggar hak mereka?
decisions.held: No. The exclusion in Article 63 was upheld.
decisions.plain: A Cambodian farm worker in Korea challenged the rule that farm workers get no legal limits on hours or rest days. The Constitutional Court kept the rule.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja pertanian asal Kamboja di Korea menggugat aturan bahwa pekerja pertanian tidak punya batas jam kerja atau hari libur. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.name: GA and others v. Director of Immigration
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Do refugees and torture claimants in Hong Kong have a constitutional right to work?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pengungsi dan pemohon perlindungan dari penyiksaan di Hong Kong punya hak konstitusional untuk bekerja?
decisions.held: No. The Basic Law’s freedom to choose an occupation does not extend to people without the right to take up employment; the Director keeps discretion to permit work.
decisions.plain: People waiting years for their protection claims in Hong Kong were not allowed to work. The highest court said they have no right to work, though the government may allow it case by case.
decisions.plain_id: Orang yang bertahun-tahun menunggu permohonan perlindungan di Hong Kong tidak boleh bekerja. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka tidak punya hak bekerja, walau pemerintah boleh mengizinkan kasus per kasus.

decisions.name: ZN v. Secretary for Justice
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Does the Bill of Rights’ ban on forced labour oblige Hong Kong to have a specific offence of human trafficking?
decisions.q_id: Apakah larangan kerja paksa dalam Bill of Rights mewajibkan Hong Kong memiliki tindak pidana perdagangan orang tersendiri?
decisions.held: No. Article 4 prohibits slavery, servitude and forced labour but does not require a specific trafficking offence. [Check reasoning.]
decisions.plain: A Pakistani man said he was made to work for years in Hong Kong without pay. He argued Hong Kong must have a crime of human trafficking. The highest court disagreed.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Pakistan mengaku dipaksa bekerja bertahun-tahun di Hong Kong tanpa upah. Ia berargumen Hong Kong wajib punya tindak pidana perdagangan orang. Pengadilan tertinggi tidak setuju.

after.en: Court of First Instance finds a breach but no duty to legislate. [Check.]
after.id: Pengadilan tingkat pertama menemukan pelanggaran tetapi tanpa kewajiban membuat UU. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: HKSAR v. Law Wan-tung (Erwiana Sulistyaningsih case)
decisions.q: Was the employer of an Indonesian domestic worker guilty of assault, criminal intimidation and failing to pay wages and give rest days?
decisions.q_id: Apakah majikan pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia bersalah atas penganiayaan, ancaman dan tidak membayar upah serta hari libur?
decisions.held: Yes on 18 of 20 charges; sentenced to six years’ imprisonment and a fine.
decisions.plain: An Indonesian domestic worker was badly beaten by her employer and sent home barely able to walk. Her case caused protests. The court convicted the employer and sent her to prison for six years.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dianiaya berat oleh majikannya dan dipulangkan dalam keadaan hampir tak bisa berjalan. Kasusnya memicu protes. Pengadilan memvonis majikan dan memenjarakannya enam tahun.

after.id: Pekerja pulang ke Indonesia dalam keadaan terluka.

after.en: Civil damages awarded to the worker. [Check.]
after.id: Ganti rugi perdata diberikan kepada pekerja. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: HKSAR v. Tai Chi-wai and Catherine Au Yuk-shan (Kartika Puspitasari case)
decisions.q: Were a couple guilty of the long-term abuse of their Indonesian domestic worker?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pasangan suami istri bersalah atas penganiayaan jangka panjang terhadap pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia mereka?
decisions.held: Yes. Both were convicted and imprisoned. [Check sentences.]
decisions.plain: An Indonesian domestic worker was abused for two years by her employers. A Hong Kong court convicted both employers and sent them to prison.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia dianiaya selama dua tahun oleh majikannya. Pengadilan Hong Kong memvonis kedua majikan dan memenjarakan mereka.

decisions.name: Comilang v. Director of Immigration
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: May mothers without residence rights stay in Hong Kong to care for their children who are permanent residents?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah ibu tanpa hak tinggal tetap di Hong Kong untuk merawat anak mereka yang penduduk tetap?
decisions.held: No. The Basic Law and Bill of Rights do not give a right to remain; immigration control is protected by a reservation.
decisions.plain: Former domestic workers from the Philippines and Indonesia had children who are Hong Kong permanent residents. They asked to stay to raise them. The highest court said they had no right to stay.
decisions.plain_id: Mantan pekerja rumah tangga dari Filipina dan Indonesia punya anak yang menjadi penduduk tetap Hong Kong. Mereka meminta tinggal untuk membesarkan anak-anak itu. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka tidak berhak tinggal.

decisions.name: Kong Yunming v. Director of Social Welfare
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Is the seven-year residence requirement for comprehensive social security assistance constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah syarat tinggal tujuh tahun untuk bantuan jaminan sosial konstitusional?
decisions.held: No. The requirement, raised from one year to seven in 2004, was unconstitutional; the one-year rule was restored.
decisions.plain: A woman who moved from mainland China to Hong Kong was refused welfare because she had not lived there seven years. The highest court said this rule was unconstitutional.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan yang pindah dari Tiongkok daratan ke Hong Kong ditolak bantuan sosial karena belum tinggal tujuh tahun. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan aturan itu inkonstitusional.

decisions.name: Fok Chun Wa v. Hospital Authority
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: May public hospitals charge mainland wives of Hong Kong residents higher fees for giving birth?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah rumah sakit umum mengenakan biaya persalinan lebih tinggi kepada istri asal daratan dari penduduk Hong Kong?
decisions.held: Yes. The fee policy was a justified use of limited public resources.
decisions.plain: Women from mainland China married to Hong Kong men were charged much more to give birth in public hospitals. The highest court let the higher fees stand.
decisions.plain_id: Perempuan dari Tiongkok daratan yang menikah dengan pria Hong Kong dikenakan biaya persalinan jauh lebih tinggi di rumah sakit umum. Pengadilan tertinggi mempertahankan biaya itu.

decisions.name: Public Prosecutor v. Gaiyathiri d/o Murugayan
decisions.q: What sentence should an employer receive for the abuse and killing of her Myanmar domestic worker?
decisions.q_id: Hukuman apa yang pantas bagi majikan yang menganiaya dan membunuh pekerja rumah tangga asal Myanmar?
decisions.held: Life imprisonment, after she pleaded guilty to culpable homicide and other charges.
decisions.plain: A young domestic worker from Myanmar was starved and beaten to death by her employer in Singapore. The High Court sentenced the employer to life in prison. Others in the household were also prosecuted.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga muda dari Myanmar dibuat kelaparan dan dipukuli sampai meninggal oleh majikannya di Singapura. Pengadilan Tinggi menghukum majikan penjara seumur hidup. Anggota rumah tangga lain juga dituntut.

decisions.name: Public Prosecutor v. Tay Wee Kiat and Chua Ying Ling
decisions.q: Were the sentences for a couple who abused their Myanmar domestic worker adequate?
decisions.q_id: Apakah hukuman bagi pasangan yang menganiaya pekerja rumah tangga asal Myanmar sudah memadai?
decisions.held: The High Court increased the sentences on appeal. [Check figures.]
decisions.plain: A couple in Singapore abused their domestic worker from Myanmar for months. On appeal the High Court gave them longer prison terms.
decisions.plain_id: Pasangan di Singapura menganiaya pekerja rumah tangga mereka dari Myanmar selama berbulan-bulan. Di tingkat banding, Pengadilan Tinggi memperberat hukuman penjara mereka.

decisions.name: Public Prosecutor v. Ambika M.A. Shan (death of Adelina Lisao)
decisions.q: Should the trial of the employer accused of the murder of an Indonesian domestic worker go ahead?
decisions.q_id: Apakah persidangan majikan yang didakwa membunuh pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia harus dilanjutkan?
decisions.held: The court granted a discharge amounting to acquittal after the prosecution withdrew; later appeals did not restore the charge. [Check appellate history.]
decisions.plain: Adelina, a young Indonesian domestic worker, died in Malaysia after being made to sleep outside with a dog and left with untreated wounds. The employer was freed when the prosecution dropped the case, causing protests in both countries.
decisions.plain_id: Adelina, pekerja rumah tangga muda Indonesia, meninggal di Malaysia setelah dipaksa tidur di luar bersama anjing dan lukanya tidak dirawat. Majikan dibebaskan saat jaksa mencabut perkara, memicu protes di kedua negara.

decisions.name: Public Prosecutor v. Yim Pek Ha (Nirmala Bonat case)
decisions.q: Was the employer guilty of causing grievous hurt to her Indonesian domestic worker?
decisions.q_id: Apakah majikan bersalah menyebabkan luka berat pada pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia?
decisions.held: Yes; she was sentenced to 18 years. Later appeals reduced the sentence. [Check final sentence.]
decisions.plain: Nirmala, a domestic worker from Indonesia, was burned with an iron and scalded by her employer in Kuala Lumpur. The court convicted the employer and sent her to prison.
decisions.plain_id: Nirmala, pekerja rumah tangga dari Indonesia, disetrika dan disiram air panas oleh majikannya di Kuala Lumpur. Pengadilan memvonis majikan dan memenjarakannya.

decisions.name: 93 migrant workers left without jobs on arrival
decisions.q: Must an employer pay wages to migrant workers it brought to Malaysia but never gave work?
decisions.q_id: Apakah majikan wajib membayar upah pekerja migran yang didatangkannya ke Malaysia tetapi tidak diberi pekerjaan?
decisions.held: Yes. The High Court upheld a Labour Court award of more than RM760,000 in back pay to 93 workers.
decisions.plain: Ninety-three workers arrived in Malaysia in 2023 and found there were no jobs for them. The Labour Court ordered the employer to pay them, and the High Court agreed.
decisions.plain_id: Sembilan puluh tiga pekerja tiba di Malaysia pada 2023 dan ternyata tidak ada pekerjaan untuk mereka. Pengadilan Ketenagakerjaan memerintahkan majikan membayar, dan Pengadilan Tinggi setuju.

decisions.name: Natural Fruit Co. v. Andy Hall
decisions.q: Was a researcher guilty of criminal defamation for a report on abuse of Myanmar workers at a pineapple factory?
decisions.q_id: Apakah peneliti bersalah atas pencemaran nama baik karena laporan tentang penganiayaan pekerja Myanmar di pabrik nanas?
decisions.held: Yes. He was convicted and given a suspended sentence and fine. [Check appeals.]
decisions.plain: A British researcher reported abuse of Myanmar workers at a Thai fruit factory. The company sued him for defamation and the court convicted him. The case was criticised for discouraging reporting of abuse.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang peneliti Inggris melaporkan penganiayaan pekerja Myanmar di pabrik buah di Thailand. Perusahaan menggugatnya atas pencemaran nama baik dan pengadilan memvonisnya. Perkara ini dikritik karena membuat orang enggan melaporkan penganiayaan.

decisions.name: Philippine Association of Service Exporters v. Drilon
decisions.q: May the government ban the deployment of women domestic workers abroad to protect them?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pemerintah melarang pengiriman perempuan pekerja rumah tangga ke luar negeri untuk melindungi mereka?
decisions.held: Yes. The deployment ban was a valid exercise of police power and did not breach equal protection.
decisions.plain: The Philippines stopped sending women abroad as domestic workers because of abuse. Recruitment agencies challenged the ban. The Supreme Court upheld it.
decisions.plain_id: Filipina menghentikan pengiriman perempuan sebagai pekerja rumah tangga karena banyak kekerasan. Agen perekrut menggugat larangan itu. MA mempertahankannya.

decisions.name: JMM Promotion and Management v. Court of Appeals
decisions.q: May the government require performers going abroad (mainly to Japan) to hold an Artist Record Book after training and testing?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pemerintah mewajibkan penghibur yang ke luar negeri (terutama ke Jepang) memiliki Buku Catatan Artis setelah pelatihan dan ujian?
decisions.held: Yes. The requirement was a reasonable protective regulation.
decisions.plain: After a Filipina performer died in Japan, the government added training and a record book for performers going abroad. Agencies said this was unfair. The Supreme Court upheld the rule.
decisions.plain_id: Setelah seorang penghibur Filipina meninggal di Jepang, pemerintah menambah pelatihan dan buku catatan bagi penghibur yang ke luar negeri. Agen menyebutnya tidak adil. MA mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.name: Becmen Service Exporter v. Cuaresma
decisions.q: Are the Philippine recruiter and the foreign employer liable to the family of a nurse who died abroad in unexplained circumstances?
decisions.q_id: Apakah agen perekrut Filipina dan majikan asing bertanggung jawab kepada keluarga perawat yang meninggal di luar negeri dalam keadaan tak jelas?
decisions.held: Yes. The agency and employer were held liable for damages for failing in their duties to the worker. [Check award.]
decisions.plain: A young Filipina nurse died in Saudi Arabia and the employer called it suicide. Her parents sued. The Supreme Court held the recruitment agency and the employer liable to the family.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perawat muda Filipina meninggal di Arab Saudi dan majikan menyebutnya bunuh diri. Orang tuanya menggugat. MA menyatakan agen dan majikan bertanggung jawab kepada keluarga.

decisions.name: Datuman v. First Cosmopolitan Manpower
decisions.q: Is the Philippine agency liable when the worker is made to sign a worse contract on arrival abroad?
decisions.q_id: Apakah agen Filipina bertanggung jawab jika pekerja dipaksa menandatangani kontrak yang lebih buruk setibanya di luar negeri?
decisions.held: Yes. Contract substitution is prohibited and the agency is jointly liable for the difference.
decisions.plain: A Filipina sent to Saudi Arabia was made to sign a new contract with worse pay and work. The Supreme Court said the agency in the Philippines must pay what she lost.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan Filipina yang dikirim ke Arab Saudi dipaksa menandatangani kontrak baru dengan upah dan pekerjaan lebih buruk. MA menyatakan agen di Filipina wajib membayar kerugiannya.

decisions.name: People’s Union for Democratic Rights v. Union of India (Asiad workers)
decisions.q: Were migrant construction workers building the 1982 Asian Games venues entitled to the minimum wage and other labour protections?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pekerja bangunan migran yang membangun arena Asian Games 1982 berhak atas upah minimum dan perlindungan lain?
decisions.held: Yes. Paying less than the minimum wage is forced labour under Article 23; the State must enforce labour laws against contractors.
decisions.plain: Workers from other states built stadiums in Delhi for the Asian Games and were paid less than the legal minimum. The Supreme Court said paying below the minimum wage is a form of forced labour.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja dari negara bagian lain membangun stadion di Delhi untuk Asian Games dan dibayar di bawah upah minimum. MA menyatakan membayar di bawah upah minimum adalah bentuk kerja paksa.

decisions.name: Bandhua Mukti Morcha v. Union of India
decisions.q: Must the State identify, free and rehabilitate bonded migrant workers in the Faridabad quarries?
decisions.q_id: Apakah negara wajib mengidentifikasi, membebaskan dan memulihkan pekerja migran terjerat utang di tambang batu Faridabad?
decisions.held: Yes. The Court issued detailed directions for release, rehabilitation and enforcement of labour laws.
decisions.plain: Workers brought from other states to stone quarries near Delhi were trapped by debts. The Supreme Court ordered the government to free them and enforce labour laws.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja yang didatangkan dari negara bagian lain ke tambang batu dekat Delhi terjerat utang. MA memerintahkan pemerintah membebaskan mereka dan menegakkan hukum ketenagakerjaan.

decisions.name: Labourers Working on Salal Hydro Project v. State of Jammu and Kashmir
decisions.q: Must the Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act and other labour laws be enforced for workers on a public dam project?
decisions.q_id: Apakah UU Pekerja Migran Antar-Negara Bagian dan UU ketenagakerjaan lain wajib ditegakkan bagi pekerja proyek bendungan pemerintah?
decisions.held: Yes. The Court directed enforcement, including against child labour on the site.
decisions.plain: Workers from other states building a dam were denied basic labour rights. The Supreme Court ordered the authorities to apply the law that protects workers who migrate between states.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja dari negara bagian lain yang membangun bendungan tidak mendapat hak dasar. MA memerintahkan otoritas menerapkan UU yang melindungi pekerja yang merantau antarnegara bagian.

decisions.name: National Campaign Committee for Central Legislation on Construction Labour v. Union of India
decisions.q: Were the welfare funds collected from builders for construction workers actually being used for them?
decisions.q_id: Apakah dana kesejahteraan yang dipungut dari kontraktor untuk pekerja bangunan benar-benar dipakai untuk mereka?
decisions.held: No. The Court found large sums unspent or misused and directed registration of workers and a model welfare scheme.
decisions.plain: India collects a levy on building projects for construction workers, many of them migrants. The Supreme Court found most of the money was not reaching them and ordered the government to register workers and use the funds properly.
decisions.plain_id: India memungut iuran dari proyek bangunan untuk pekerja konstruksi, banyak di antaranya perantau. MA menemukan sebagian besar dana tidak sampai kepada mereka dan memerintahkan pendataan pekerja serta penggunaan dana dengan benar.

decisions.name: Darshan Masih v. The State (brick kiln workers)
decisions.q: Must the State end bonded labour in brick kilns and protect workers who escape it?
decisions.q_id: Apakah negara wajib mengakhiri kerja ijon di tempat pembakaran batu bata dan melindungi pekerja yang melarikan diri?
decisions.held: Yes. The Court held bonded labour unconstitutional and gave interim directions; Parliament later passed the Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act 1992.
decisions.plain: Families working in brick kilns in Pakistan were trapped by debts they could never repay. The Supreme Court said this was unconstitutional and ordered protection. A law banning bonded labour followed in 1992.
decisions.plain_id: Keluarga yang bekerja di tempat pembakaran batu bata di Pakistan terjerat utang yang tak mungkin dilunasi. MA menyatakan ini inkonstitusional dan memerintahkan perlindungan. UU yang melarang kerja ijon menyusul pada 1992.

decisions.name: Kav LaOved v. Ministry of Interior (pregnancy procedure)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Israel (sitting as High Court of Justice)
decisions.q: May a migrant worker lose her permit and be required to leave because she gives birth?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pekerja migran kehilangan izin dan wajib pergi karena melahirkan?
decisions.held: No. The procedure that forced migrant workers who gave birth to leave with the baby, or send the baby abroad, disproportionately harmed the right to parenthood and was struck down.
decisions.plain: Israel’s rules said a migrant worker who had a baby had to leave the country or send the baby away. The Supreme Court said this rule was unlawful and cancelled it.
decisions.plain_id: Aturan Israel mewajibkan pekerja migran yang melahirkan meninggalkan negara itu atau mengirim bayinya keluar. MA menyatakan aturan itu tidak sah dan membatalkannya.

after.en: A revised procedure keeps limits on staying with the child. [Check.]
after.id: Prosedur baru masih membatasi tinggal bersama anak. [Periksa.]
