decisions.held: Yes. The ten-year wait was a reasonable distinction and did not breach equality.
decisions.plain: A woman from mainland China married a Taiwanese man, became a resident and was hired as a civil servant, then dismissed under the ten-year rule. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Tiongkok daratan menikah dengan pria Taiwan, menjadi penduduk, dan diangkat sebagai pegawai negeri, lalu diberhentikan berdasarkan aturan sepuluh tahun. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.name: Ng Ka Ling v. Director of Immigration
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Do children born in mainland China to Hong Kong permanent residents have the right of abode, without first getting an exit permit?
decisions.q_id: Apakah anak yang lahir di Tiongkok daratan dari penduduk tetap Hong Kong punya hak tinggal, tanpa harus mendapat izin keluar dulu?
decisions.held: Yes. The right of abode in the Basic Law could not be made subject to a one-way permit scheme or limited to children born after a parent became a resident.
decisions.plain: Thousands of children in mainland China had a parent living in Hong Kong. The top court said they had the right to live in Hong Kong. Months later, an interpretation by China’s legislature limited the effect of the ruling.
decisions.plain_id: Ribuan anak di Tiongkok daratan punya orang tua yang tinggal di Hong Kong. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan mereka berhak tinggal di Hong Kong. Beberapa bulan kemudian, tafsir badan legislatif Tiongkok membatasi akibat putusan itu.

after.en: Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress interprets the Basic Law.
after.id: Komite Tetap Kongres Rakyat Nasional menafsirkan Basic Law.

decisions.name: Director of Immigration v. Chong Fung Yuen
decisions.court: Court of Final Appeal, Hong Kong
decisions.q: Does a Chinese citizen born in Hong Kong have the right of abode even if neither parent is a resident?
decisions.q_id: Apakah warga Tiongkok yang lahir di Hong Kong punya hak tinggal meski orang tuanya bukan penduduk?
decisions.held: Yes. Under the plain words of the Basic Law, birth in Hong Kong is enough.
decisions.plain: A boy was born in Hong Kong to parents from mainland China who were visiting. The top court said he had the right to live in Hong Kong because he was born there.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang anak laki-laki lahir di Hong Kong dari orang tua asal Tiongkok daratan yang sedang berkunjung. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan ia berhak tinggal di Hong Kong karena lahir di sana.

after.en: Hospitals stop booking births for non-resident mothers.
after.id: Rumah sakit berhenti menerima pendaftaran persalinan ibu bukan penduduk.

decisions.name: Gaygusuz v. Austria
decisions.q: May a state refuse emergency unemployment assistance to a foreign worker who paid contributions, because of his nationality?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara menolak bantuan darurat pengangguran bagi pekerja asing yang sudah membayar iuran, karena kewarganegaraannya?
decisions.held: No. Only very weighty reasons could justify a difference based on nationality; the refusal breached Article 14 with Article 1 of Protocol No. 1.
decisions.plain: A Turkish worker in Austria who had paid into the system was refused emergency benefits because he was not Austrian. The European Court said this was discrimination.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pekerja Turki di Austria yang sudah membayar iuran ditolak tunjangan darurat karena bukan warga Austria. Mahkamah Eropa menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

decisions.name: Koua Poirrez v. France
decisions.q: May a disability allowance be refused to a lawfully resident foreigner because of his nationality?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah tunjangan disabilitas ditolak bagi orang asing yang tinggal secara sah karena kewarganegaraannya?
decisions.held: No. Refusing the allowance on grounds of nationality breached Article 14 with Article 1 of Protocol No. 1.
decisions.plain: A man from Côte d’Ivoire with a disability, living lawfully in France, was refused an allowance because he was not French or from a treaty country. The Court found discrimination.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria penyandang disabilitas dari Pantai Gading yang tinggal sah di Prancis ditolak tunjangan karena bukan warga Prancis atau negara mitra perjanjian. Mahkamah menemukan diskriminasi.

decisions.name: Andrejeva v. Latvia (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: May a pension count years worked in the former Soviet Union for citizens but not for permanently resident non-citizens?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pensiun menghitung masa kerja di bekas Uni Soviet bagi warga negara tetapi tidak bagi penduduk tetap bukan warga negara?
decisions.held: No. The difference in treatment based on nationality lacked an objective and reasonable justification.
decisions.plain: A long-term resident of Latvia without citizenship got a smaller pension than citizens for the same work history. The Grand Chamber said this was discrimination.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang penduduk lama Latvia tanpa kewarganegaraan mendapat pensiun lebih kecil daripada warga negara untuk riwayat kerja yang sama. Majelis Agung menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

decisions.name: Ponomaryovi v. Bulgaria
decisions.q: May secondary school fees be charged to foreign children because their parent lacks permanent residence?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah biaya sekolah menengah dikenakan kepada anak asing karena orang tuanya tidak punya izin tinggal tetap?
decisions.held: No. In the circumstances, charging fees on the basis of immigration status breached Article 14 with Article 2 of Protocol No. 1.
decisions.plain: Two Russian boys living in Bulgaria with their mother had to pay school fees that Bulgarian pupils did not pay, because of their residence status. The Court found discrimination.
decisions.plain_id: Dua anak laki-laki Rusia yang tinggal di Bulgaria bersama ibunya harus membayar biaya sekolah yang tidak dibayar murid Bulgaria, karena status izin tinggal mereka. Mahkamah menemukan diskriminasi.

decisions.name: Biao v. Denmark (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: Does a family reunification rule that favours people who have been citizens for 28 years discriminate?
decisions.q_id: Apakah aturan penyatuan keluarga yang menguntungkan orang yang sudah 28 tahun menjadi warga negara bersifat diskriminatif?
decisions.held: Yes. The 28-year rule had a disproportionate effect on naturalised citizens of foreign ethnic origin and amounted to indirect discrimination.
decisions.plain: A Danish citizen born in Togo could not bring his wife from Ghana, while citizens by birth could. The Grand Chamber said the rule indirectly discriminated against naturalised citizens.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang warga Denmark kelahiran Togo tidak bisa membawa istrinya dari Ghana, sementara warga sejak lahir bisa. Majelis Agung menyatakan aturan itu secara tidak langsung mendiskriminasi warga hasil naturalisasi.

decisions.name: Khlaifia v. Italy (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: Were Tunisian migrants held at Lampedusa and returned under a readmission deal unlawfully detained and collectively expelled?
decisions.q_id: Apakah migran Tunisia yang ditahan di Lampedusa dan dipulangkan lewat perjanjian readmisi ditahan secara tidak sah dan diusir secara kolektif?
decisions.held: The detention lacked a legal basis and judicial review (Article 5 violated), but there was no collective expulsion because each received an individual identification.
decisions.plain: Tunisian men who arrived by boat were held on Lampedusa and on ships without a legal basis, then flown home. The Grand Chamber found unlawful detention but not a collective expulsion.
decisions.plain_id: Pria Tunisia yang tiba dengan perahu ditahan di Lampedusa dan di kapal tanpa dasar hukum, lalu diterbangkan pulang. Majelis Agung menyatakan penahanan tidak sah tetapi bukan pengusiran kolektif.

decisions.name: Hirsi Jamaa v. Italy (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: May a state intercept migrants at sea and return them to Libya without examining their situation?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara mencegat migran di laut dan memulangkan mereka ke Libya tanpa memeriksa keadaan mereka?
decisions.held: No. The pushback exposed them to ill-treatment, amounted to collective expulsion, and denied an effective remedy.
decisions.plain: Italian ships picked up Somali and Eritrean migrants at sea and took them straight back to Libya. The Grand Chamber said this broke the ban on sending people to danger and on group expulsions.
decisions.plain_id: Kapal Italia mengangkut migran Somalia dan Eritrea di laut dan langsung membawa mereka kembali ke Libya. Majelis Agung menyatakan ini melanggar larangan memulangkan orang ke bahaya dan pengusiran kelompok.

decisions.name: Čonka v. Belgium
decisions.q: Was summoning Slovak Roma families to a police station and deporting them as a group lawful?
decisions.q_id: Apakah memanggil keluarga Roma Slovakia ke kantor polisi lalu mendeportasi mereka berkelompok sah?
decisions.held: No. The arrest by a misleading summons breached liberty, and the removal was a collective expulsion without an effective remedy.
decisions.plain: Belgian police asked Roma families to come in to “complete their files”, then arrested and deported them together. The Court found an unlawful collective expulsion.
decisions.plain_id: Polisi Belgia meminta keluarga Roma datang untuk “melengkapi berkas”, lalu menangkap dan mendeportasi mereka bersama-sama. Mahkamah menyatakan itu pengusiran kolektif yang tidak sah.

decisions.name: Kurić v. Slovenia (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: Did Slovenia breach the rights of people from other former Yugoslav republics whose residence was erased after independence?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Slovenia melanggar hak orang dari bekas republik Yugoslavia lain yang izin tinggalnya dihapus setelah kemerdekaan?
decisions.held: Yes. The “erasure” breached private and family life and equality, and the state had to set up a compensation scheme.
decisions.plain: In 1992 more than 25,000 long-term residents of Slovenia from other Yugoslav republics were wiped from the residence register and lost their jobs and rights. The Grand Chamber said Slovenia must compensate them.
decisions.plain_id: Pada 1992 lebih dari 25.000 penduduk lama Slovenia dari republik Yugoslavia lain dihapus dari daftar penduduk dan kehilangan pekerjaan serta hak. Majelis Agung menyatakan Slovenia wajib memberi ganti rugi.

decisions.name: Paposhvili v. Belgium (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: May a seriously ill man be deported without checking whether he would get treatment at home?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah orang yang sakit parah dideportasi tanpa memeriksa apakah ia akan mendapat perawatan di negaranya?
decisions.held: No. Removal would breach Article 3 where there is a real risk of serious, rapid and irreversible decline due to lack of treatment, unless the state assesses that risk.
decisions.plain: A Georgian man with leukaemia faced deportation from Belgium. The Grand Chamber said Belgium had to check whether he could get treatment before sending him away.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Georgia penderita leukemia akan dideportasi dari Belgia. Majelis Agung menyatakan Belgia wajib memeriksa apakah ia bisa mendapat perawatan sebelum memulangkannya.

decisions.name: Jeunesse v. the Netherlands (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: Must a mother without residence status be allowed to stay with her children who are citizens?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah ibu tanpa izin tinggal diizinkan tinggal bersama anak-anaknya yang warga negara?
decisions.held: Yes, in the circumstances. Refusing her residence failed to give enough weight to the best interests of the children.
decisions.plain: A woman from Suriname had lived in the Netherlands for 16 years with her Dutch husband and children but had no residence permit. The Grand Chamber said refusing her one breached family life.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Suriname tinggal 16 tahun di Belanda bersama suami dan anak-anaknya yang warga Belanda tetapi tidak punya izin tinggal. Majelis Agung menyatakan penolakan izin melanggar hak keluarga.

decisions.name: Saadi v. the United Kingdom (Grand Chamber)
decisions.q: May an asylum seeker be detained for a week for fast-track processing even though he poses no risk of absconding?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pencari suaka ditahan seminggu untuk pemrosesan cepat meski tidak berisiko kabur?
decisions.held: Yes. Short detention to process a claim quickly falls within Article 5(1)(f), provided it is not arbitrary; but the delay in giving reasons breached Article 5(2).
decisions.plain: An Iraqi asylum seeker was held for seven days at a centre so his claim could be decided fast. The Grand Chamber said this was allowed.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pencari suaka Irak ditahan tujuh hari di sebuah pusat agar permohonannya cepat diputus. Majelis Agung menyatakan itu boleh.

decisions.name: J. and Others v. Austria
decisions.q: Must Austria investigate trafficking of domestic workers that mostly happened abroad before their employers brought them to Vienna?
decisions.q_id: Wajibkah Austria menyelidiki perdagangan pekerja rumah tangga yang sebagian besar terjadi di luar negeri sebelum majikan membawa mereka ke Wina?
decisions.held: No. Austria identified the women as possible victims and protected them in Austria; Article 4 did not require it to investigate acts committed abroad.
decisions.plain: Filipino domestic workers said they had been exploited abroad and then in Vienna, where they escaped. Austria protected them but did not prosecute. The Court said Austria had done enough.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja rumah tangga Filipina mengaku dieksploitasi di luar negeri lalu di Wina, tempat mereka melarikan diri. Austria melindungi mereka tetapi tidak menuntut. Mahkamah menyatakan Austria sudah cukup bertindak.

decisions.name: V.C.L. and A.N. v. the United Kingdom
decisions.q: May trafficked children forced to work on cannabis farms be prosecuted for drug offences?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah anak korban perdagangan yang dipaksa bekerja di ladang ganja dituntut atas kejahatan narkotika?
decisions.held: No, not without first assessing whether they were trafficked. Prosecuting them breached Article 4 and the fairness of the trial under Article 6.
decisions.plain: Two Vietnamese teenagers found working on cannabis farms in England were prosecuted instead of being treated as trafficking victims. The Court said this broke the Convention.
decisions.plain_id: Dua remaja Vietnam yang ditemukan bekerja di ladang ganja di Inggris dituntut alih-alih diperlakukan sebagai korban perdagangan orang. Mahkamah menyatakan ini melanggar Konvensi.

decisions.name: Zoletić and Others v. Azerbaijan
decisions.q: Did Azerbaijan fail to investigate the trafficking of migrant construction workers from Bosnia and Herzegovina?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Azerbaijan lalai menyelidiki perdagangan pekerja konstruksi migran dari Bosnia dan Herzegovina?
decisions.held: Yes. Despite credible reports, the authorities did not investigate the alleged forced labour and trafficking, breaching Article 4.
decisions.plain: Men from Bosnia were taken to build in Azerbaijan, had their passports taken and were not paid. The authorities did not investigate. The Court found a breach of the duty to investigate.
decisions.plain_id: Pria dari Bosnia dibawa untuk membangun di Azerbaijan, paspornya ditahan dan tidak digaji. Pihak berwenang tidak menyelidiki. Mahkamah menemukan pelanggaran kewajiban menyelidiki.

decisions.name: Popov v. France
decisions.q: May young children be held with their parents in immigration detention?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah anak kecil ditahan bersama orang tuanya dalam detensi imigrasi?
decisions.held: No, not in these conditions. Holding the children breached Articles 3, 5 and 8, and alternatives to detention had to be considered.
decisions.plain: A family from Kazakhstan, with a baby and a three-year-old, was held for two weeks in an immigration detention centre. The Court said this harmed the children and broke the Convention.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah keluarga dari Kazakhstan, dengan bayi dan anak tiga tahun, ditahan dua minggu di pusat detensi imigrasi. Mahkamah menyatakan ini merugikan anak dan melanggar Konvensi.

decisions.name: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs (detention at ports of entry)
decisions.q: Do people refused entry and held at ports or on ships have the same protection as other immigration detainees?
decisions.q_id: Apakah orang yang ditolak masuk dan ditahan di pelabuhan atau kapal mendapat perlindungan yang sama dengan tahanan imigrasi lain?
decisions.held: Yes. The safeguards of section 34(1), including review by a court, also apply to people held at ports of entry. [Check reasoning.]
decisions.plain: People stopped at South African airports and harbours could be held without the protections other detainees have. The Constitutional Court said the same protections apply to them.
decisions.plain_id: Orang yang dihentikan di bandara dan pelabuhan Afrika Selatan bisa ditahan tanpa perlindungan yang dimiliki tahanan lain. MK menyatakan perlindungan yang sama berlaku bagi mereka.

src.t: Constitutional Court of South Africa, judgment archive

decisions.name: Mohamed v. President of the Republic of South Africa
decisions.q: Could South Africa hand a man over to the United States to face a possible death sentence without assurances?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Afrika Selatan menyerahkan seseorang kepada Amerika Serikat untuk menghadapi kemungkinan hukuman mati tanpa jaminan?
decisions.held: No. Removing him without an assurance that the death penalty would not be imposed breached his rights to life, dignity and freedom from cruel punishment.
decisions.plain: A Tanzanian man was quickly sent from South Africa to the United States to stand trial for an embassy bombing. The Constitutional Court said this was unlawful without a promise that he would not be executed.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Tanzania segera dikirim dari Afrika Selatan ke Amerika Serikat untuk diadili atas pengeboman kedutaan. MK menyatakan ini tidak sah tanpa janji ia tidak akan dihukum mati.

after.en: Judgment sent to the US trial court.
Sentenced to life imprisonment, not death.
after.id: Dihukum penjara seumur hidup, bukan mati.

src.t: Constitutional Court of South Africa, judgment archive
lawlibrary.org.za - confirmed via official search listing (judgment)

decisions.name: Zimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights and IHRDA (on behalf of Andrew Meldrum) v. Zimbabwe
decisions.court: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.q: Could Zimbabwe expel a foreign journalist in defiance of its own courts’ orders?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Zimbabwe mengusir wartawan asing dengan mengabaikan perintah pengadilannya sendiri?
decisions.held: No. The expulsion, carried out despite court orders, breached his rights to a hearing and to free expression.
decisions.plain: A US journalist who had lived and worked in Zimbabwe for over 20 years was deported even though courts had ordered that he could stay. The African Commission found a breach.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang wartawan AS yang tinggal dan bekerja di Zimbabwe lebih dari 20 tahun dideportasi padahal pengadilan sudah memerintahkan ia boleh tinggal. Komisi Afrika menemukan pelanggaran.

decisions.name: Hadijatou Mani Koraou v. Niger
decisions.q: Is the state responsible when its courts fail to protect a woman held in slavery?
decisions.q_id: Apakah negara bertanggung jawab ketika pengadilannya gagal melindungi perempuan yang diperbudak?
decisions.held: Yes. Niger’s authorities tolerated her enslavement and failed to protect her, and the state had to pay compensation.
decisions.plain: A girl was sold at 12 and made to do domestic and farm work as a so-called “fifth wife”. The ECOWAS court said Niger failed to protect her and ordered compensation.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang anak perempuan dijual pada usia 12 tahun dan dipaksa melakukan kerja rumah tangga dan pertanian sebagai yang disebut “istri kelima”. Pengadilan ECOWAS menyatakan Niger gagal melindunginya dan memerintahkan ganti rugi.

after.en: Judgment; compensation of 10 million CFA francs.
after.id: Putusan; ganti rugi 10 juta franc CFA.

decisions.name: MRG and SOS-Esclaves (Said and Yarg Ould Salem) v. Mauritania
decisions.court: African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
decisions.q: Did Mauritania fail to protect two boys held in slavery and to punish those responsible?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Mauritania gagal melindungi dua anak laki-laki yang diperbudak dan menghukum pelakunya?
decisions.held: Yes. The state breached the children’s rights by failing to prevent their enslavement and by the weak prosecution that followed.
decisions.plain: Two brothers were made to herd animals and work without pay from childhood. A court gave the man responsible a light sentence. The African children’s rights committee said Mauritania failed them.
decisions.plain_id: Dua bersaudara dipaksa menggembala ternak dan bekerja tanpa upah sejak kecil. Pengadilan menjatuhkan hukuman ringan kepada pelakunya. Komite hak anak Afrika menyatakan Mauritania gagal melindungi mereka.

after.en: Domestic conviction with a light sentence.
after.id: Vonis dalam negeri dengan hukuman ringan.

decisions.name: Namah v. Pato (Manus Island detention)
decisions.court: Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea
decisions.q: Is the detention of asylum seekers brought to Manus Island by Australia constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penahanan pencari suaka yang dibawa Australia ke Pulau Manus konstitusional?
decisions.held: No. The detention breached the constitutional right to personal liberty, and both governments were ordered to take steps to end it.
decisions.plain: Australia sent asylum seekers to a centre on Manus Island in Papua New Guinea. The Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea said holding them there was unconstitutional.
decisions.plain_id: Australia mengirim pencari suaka ke sebuah pusat di Pulau Manus, Papua Nugini. MA Papua Nugini menyatakan penahanan mereka di sana inkonstitusional.

after.en: Centre closed; men moved to other facilities on the island.
after.id: Pusat ditutup; para pria dipindahkan ke fasilitas lain di pulau itu.

decisions.name: Plaintiff M70/2011 v. Minister for Immigration (Malaysia arrangement)
decisions.q: Could Australia send asylum seekers to Malaysia under a swap arrangement?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah Australia mengirim pencari suaka ke Malaysia lewat pengaturan pertukaran?
decisions.held: No. The Minister’s declaration was invalid because Malaysia was not legally bound to provide the protections the Migration Act required.
decisions.plain: Australia agreed to send 800 asylum seekers to Malaysia in exchange for refugees. The High Court said this was unlawful because Malaysia was not bound to protect them.
decisions.plain_id: Australia sepakat mengirim 800 pencari suaka ke Malaysia sebagai tukar dengan pengungsi. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah karena Malaysia tidak terikat untuk melindungi mereka.

decisions.name: NZYQ v. Minister for Immigration (indefinite detention)
decisions.q: May a non-citizen be held in immigration detention indefinitely when there is no real prospect of removal?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah bukan warga negara ditahan tanpa batas dalam detensi imigrasi ketika tidak ada prospek nyata untuk dikeluarkan?
decisions.held: No. Detention with no real prospect of removal in the reasonably foreseeable future is punitive and beyond the Commonwealth’s power; Al-Kateb (2004) was overruled.
decisions.plain: A stateless Rohingya man had been held for years because no country would take him. The High Court said this was unlawful, and more than 100 people were released.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria Rohingya tanpa kewarganegaraan ditahan bertahun-tahun karena tidak ada negara yang mau menerimanya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah, dan lebih dari 100 orang dibebaskan.

after.en: New laws impose visa conditions on those released.
after.id: UU baru menetapkan syarat visa bagi yang dibebaskan.

decisions.name: Ye v. Minister of Immigration
decisions.q: Must the interests of children born in New Zealand be weighed before their overstaying parents are removed?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah kepentingan anak yang lahir di Selandia Baru ditimbang sebelum orang tuanya yang melebihi izin tinggal dikeluarkan?
decisions.held: Yes. Immigration officers must properly consider the children’s interests, and the cases were sent back for reconsideration.
decisions.plain: Chinese families who had overstayed their visas faced removal, and their children were born in New Zealand. The Supreme Court said officials must properly consider what removal would mean for the children.
decisions.plain_id: Keluarga Tiongkok yang melebihi masa visa akan dikeluarkan, dan anak-anak mereka lahir di Selandia Baru. MA menyatakan pejabat harus menimbang dengan benar dampak pengusiran bagi anak-anak.

decisions.name: Teitiota v. Chief Executive, Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment
decisions.q: Can a man from Kiribati be protected as a refugee because rising seas threaten his home?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah seorang pria dari Kiribati dilindungi sebagai pengungsi karena naiknya permukaan laut mengancam rumahnya?
decisions.held: No, on these facts. He did not face serious harm amounting to persecution, but the court did not rule out that climate change could found a claim in future.
decisions.plain: A man from Kiribati said he could not go home because the sea was swallowing his island. The Supreme Court refused his claim but left the door open for future cases.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pria dari Kiribati mengatakan ia tidak bisa pulang karena laut menenggelamkan pulaunya. MA menolak permohonannya tetapi membuka kemungkinan bagi perkara di masa depan.

decisions.name: Teitiota v. New Zealand
decisions.q: Did New Zealand breach the right to life by returning a man to Kiribati despite climate change?
decisions.q_id: Apakah Selandia Baru melanggar hak hidup dengan memulangkan seorang pria ke Kiribati meski ada perubahan iklim?
decisions.held: No violation on the facts, but the Committee said climate change can trigger the duty not to return people where it exposes them to a real risk to life.
decisions.plain: After he was sent back, the man took his case to the UN Human Rights Committee. It found no breach, but said that in future returning people to places made unliveable by climate change could break the treaty.
decisions.plain_id: Setelah dipulangkan, pria itu membawa perkaranya ke Komite HAM PBB. Komite tidak menemukan pelanggaran, tetapi menyatakan di masa depan memulangkan orang ke tempat yang tidak layak huni akibat perubahan iklim bisa melanggar perjanjian.

decisions.name: Singh v. Minister of Employment and Immigration
decisions.q: Do refugee claimants physically in Canada have Charter rights, including an oral hearing?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pemohon status pengungsi yang berada di Kanada punya hak Piagam, termasuk sidang lisan?
decisions.held: Yes. “Everyone” in section 7 includes every person physically present in Canada, and fundamental justice required an oral hearing where credibility was at stake.
decisions.plain: Sikh refugee claimants were refused without ever being heard in person. The Supreme Court said everyone in Canada has the right to life, liberty and security, and they must get a hearing.
decisions.plain_id: Pemohon status pengungsi Sikh ditolak tanpa pernah didengar langsung. MA menyatakan setiap orang di Kanada berhak atas hidup, kebebasan, dan keamanan, dan mereka harus disidangkan.

after.en: Immigration and Refugee Board created with oral hearings.
after.id: Dewan Imigrasi dan Pengungsi dibentuk dengan sidang lisan.

decisions.name: Andrews v. Law Society of British Columbia
decisions.q: May a profession be closed to permanent residents who are not citizens?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah suatu profesi ditutup bagi penduduk tetap yang bukan warga negara?
decisions.held: No. Citizenship is an analogous ground under section 15, and the citizenship requirement for lawyers was unjustified discrimination.
decisions.plain: A British lawyer living permanently in Canada was barred from practising law because he was not a citizen. The Supreme Court said this was discrimination.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pengacara Inggris yang tinggal tetap di Kanada dilarang berpraktik karena bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

decisions.name: Baker v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
decisions.q: Must officials weigh the interests of a domestic worker’s Canadian-born children before deporting her?
decisions.q_id: Haruskah pejabat menimbang kepentingan anak-anak kelahiran Kanada dari seorang pekerja rumah tangga sebelum mendeportasinya?
decisions.held: Yes. The decision had to be attentive to the children’s best interests, and the officer’s notes raised a reasonable apprehension of bias; the deportation decision was quashed.
decisions.plain: A Jamaican woman who had worked for years as a live-in domestic worker faced deportation, leaving behind her four Canadian-born children. The Supreme Court said officials must take the children’s interests seriously.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan Jamaika yang bertahun-tahun menjadi pekerja rumah tangga tinggal di rumah majikan akan dideportasi, meninggalkan empat anaknya yang lahir di Kanada. MA menyatakan pejabat wajib serius menimbang kepentingan anak-anak.

decisions.name: Suresh v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
decisions.q: May Canada deport a refugee to a country where he faces a substantial risk of torture?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah Kanada mendeportasi pengungsi ke negara tempat ia menghadapi risiko besar penyiksaan?
decisions.held: Generally no. Deportation to torture will usually breach section 7, and the person must receive the material relied on and a chance to respond.
decisions.plain: A Sri Lankan refugee was ordered deported as a security risk although he might be tortured. The Supreme Court said this would generally be unconstitutional and sent the case back.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pengungsi Sri Lanka diperintahkan dideportasi sebagai risiko keamanan meski bisa disiksa. MA menyatakan ini umumnya inkonstitusional dan mengembalikan perkaranya.

decisions.name: Charkaoui v. Canada (Citizenship and Immigration)
decisions.q: Is detention of non-citizens under security certificates, based on secret evidence, constitutional?
decisions.q_id: Apakah penahanan bukan warga negara berdasarkan sertifikat keamanan, dengan bukti rahasia, konstitusional?
decisions.held: No, as designed. The procedure denied a fair hearing, and foreign nationals had to get the same prompt detention review as permanent residents.
decisions.plain: Non-citizens were held for years on secret evidence they could not see. The Supreme Court struck down the procedure and required prompt reviews of detention.
decisions.plain_id: Bukan warga negara ditahan bertahun-tahun berdasarkan bukti rahasia yang tidak bisa mereka lihat. MA membatalkan prosedur itu dan mewajibkan peninjauan penahanan yang cepat.

decisions.name: Dunmore v. Ontario (Attorney General)
decisions.q: May farm workers be excluded entirely from the labour relations law that protects union activity?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pekerja pertanian dikecualikan sepenuhnya dari UU hubungan kerja yang melindungi kegiatan serikat?
decisions.held: No. Excluding agricultural workers left them unable to organise and breached freedom of association.
decisions.plain: Ontario farm workers, many of them seasonal migrants, had no legal protection to form unions. The Supreme Court said total exclusion was unconstitutional.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja pertanian Ontario, banyak di antaranya migran musiman, tidak punya perlindungan hukum untuk membentuk serikat. MA menyatakan pengecualian total itu inkonstitusional.

decisions.name: Ontario (Attorney General) v. Fraser
decisions.q: Does the farm workers’ law that followed Dunmore, without collective bargaining rights, breach freedom of association?
decisions.q_id: Apakah UU pekerja pertanian pasca-Dunmore, tanpa hak berunding bersama, melanggar kebebasan berserikat?
decisions.held: No. The Act gave a process for good-faith consideration of workers’ representations, which was enough.
decisions.plain: After Dunmore, Ontario passed a law letting farm workers form associations but not bargain collectively like other workers. The Supreme Court upheld it.
decisions.plain_id: Setelah Dunmore, Ontario membuat UU yang membolehkan pekerja pertanian membentuk perkumpulan tetapi tidak berunding bersama seperti pekerja lain. MA mempertahankan UU itu.

decisions.name: Kanthasamy v. Canada (Citizenship and Immigration)
decisions.q: How should officers decide humanitarian applications to stay, especially from young people?
decisions.q_id: Bagaimana petugas harus memutus permohonan kemanusiaan untuk tetap tinggal, terutama dari orang muda?
decisions.held: Officers must weigh all relevant humanitarian factors and the best interests of the child, not apply a narrow “unusual hardship” test.
decisions.plain: A Tamil teenager who fled Sri Lanka asked to stay on humanitarian grounds and was refused. The Supreme Court said officials had looked at his case too narrowly.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang remaja Tamil yang melarikan diri dari Sri Lanka meminta tetap tinggal atas alasan kemanusiaan dan ditolak. MA menyatakan pejabat memeriksa perkaranya terlalu sempit.

decisions.name: Canadian Council for Refugees v. Canada (Safe Third Country Agreement)
decisions.q: Does returning asylum seekers to the United States under the Safe Third Country Agreement breach the Charter?
decisions.q_id: Apakah memulangkan pencari suaka ke Amerika Serikat berdasarkan Perjanjian Negara Ketiga Aman melanggar Piagam?
decisions.held: No breach of section 7, because the scheme has safety valves; the equality claim was sent back to the Federal Court.
decisions.plain: People turned back at the US border argued they faced detention and refoulement in the US. The Supreme Court upheld the scheme for now but sent the gender-discrimination argument back.
decisions.plain_id: Orang yang ditolak di perbatasan AS berpendapat mereka akan ditahan dan dipulangkan di AS. MA mempertahankan skema itu untuk sementara tetapi mengembalikan argumen diskriminasi gender.

decisions.name: Toussaint v. Canada (Attorney General)
decisions.q: Must the federal health programme cover an irregular migrant whose life is at risk?
decisions.q_id: Wajibkah program kesehatan federal menanggung migran tanpa dokumen yang nyawanya terancam?
decisions.held: No. The exclusion was caused by her unlawful status, not by the programme, and did not breach sections 7 or 15.
decisions.plain: A woman from Grenada without status in Canada was refused health coverage while seriously ill. The Canadian courts rejected her claim. The UN Human Rights Committee later found Canada in breach.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada tanpa status di Kanada ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Pengadilan Kanada menolak gugatannya. Komite HAM PBB kemudian menyatakan Kanada melanggar.

after.en: UN Human Rights Committee finds a violation.

src.t: Federal Court of Appeal decisions (front page)

decisions.name: Benkharbouche v. Embassy of Sudan
decisions.q: Can foreign states rely on immunity to block employment claims by domestic staff at their embassies?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah negara asing memakai kekebalan untuk menghalangi gugatan kerja staf rumah tangga di kedutaan mereka?
decisions.held: No, for private-law employment acts. The immunity provisions breached the right of access to a court and could not be applied to these claims.
decisions.plain: Moroccan women employed as cooks and domestic staff at embassies in London were refused their wage claims because the embassies claimed immunity. The Supreme Court let the claims go ahead.
decisions.plain_id: Perempuan Maroko yang bekerja sebagai juru masak dan staf rumah tangga di kedutaan di London tidak bisa menuntut upah karena kedutaan mengklaim kekebalan. MA mengizinkan gugatan berlanjut.

after.en: State Immunity Act amended by remedial order. [Check.]
after.id: UU Kekebalan Negara diubah melalui perintah perbaikan. [Periksa.]

decisions.name: Basfar v. Wong
decisions.q: Can a diplomat claim immunity against a claim by a domestic worker kept in conditions of modern slavery?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah diplomat mengklaim kekebalan atas gugatan pekerja rumah tangga yang ditahan dalam kondisi perbudakan modern?
decisions.held: No. Employing a domestic worker in conditions of forced labour is a “commercial activity” outside diplomatic immunity.
decisions.plain: A Filipino woman said she worked almost all day for a diplomat’s family in London, without pay and without her passport. The Supreme Court said the diplomat could not use immunity to avoid her claim.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan Filipina mengaku bekerja hampir sepanjang hari untuk keluarga diplomat di London, tanpa upah dan tanpa paspornya. MA menyatakan diplomat itu tidak bisa memakai kekebalan untuk menghindari gugatannya.

decisions.name: Plyler v. Doe
decisions.court: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.q: May a state deny free public schooling to children who are in the country without authorisation?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara bagian menolak sekolah umum gratis bagi anak yang berada di negara itu tanpa izin?
decisions.held: No. Undocumented children are “persons” protected by the Equal Protection Clause, and denying them education was not justified.
decisions.plain: Texas let schools charge or exclude children without immigration papers. The Supreme Court said this broke the constitutional guarantee of equal protection.
decisions.plain_id: Texas membolehkan sekolah memungut biaya atau menolak anak tanpa dokumen imigrasi. MA menyatakan ini melanggar jaminan konstitusional atas perlindungan yang sama.

decisions.name: Graham v. Richardson
decisions.court: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.q: May states deny welfare benefits to lawfully resident non-citizens or impose long residence requirements on them?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah negara bagian menolak tunjangan sosial bagi bukan warga negara yang tinggal sah atau mensyaratkan masa tinggal panjang?
decisions.held: No. Classifications based on alienage are inherently suspect and these restrictions breached equal protection.
decisions.plain: Arizona and Pennsylvania denied welfare to non-citizen residents. The Supreme Court said treating lawful residents worse because they are not citizens needs strong justification, which was missing.
decisions.plain_id: Arizona dan Pennsylvania menolak tunjangan sosial bagi penduduk bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan memperlakukan penduduk sah lebih buruk karena bukan warga negara butuh alasan kuat, yang tidak ada.

after.en: Federal welfare reform restricts benefits for many non-citizens.
after.id: Reformasi kesejahteraan federal membatasi tunjangan bagi banyak bukan warga negara.

decisions.name: Zadvydas v. Davis
decisions.court: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.q: May non-citizens ordered removed be detained indefinitely when no country will accept them?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah bukan warga negara yang diperintahkan keluar ditahan tanpa batas ketika tidak ada negara yang mau menerima mereka?
decisions.held: No. The statute implicitly limits detention to a period reasonably necessary for removal, presumptively six months.
decisions.plain: Men who could not be deported because no country would take them were held for years. The Supreme Court said detention after about six months must end unless removal is likely soon.
decisions.plain_id: Pria yang tidak bisa dideportasi karena tidak ada negara yang menerima ditahan bertahun-tahun. MA menyatakan penahanan setelah sekitar enam bulan harus berakhir kecuali pemulangan segera mungkin.

decisions.name: Bachpan Bachao Andolan v. Union of India (children in circuses)
decisions.q: Must the state rescue children, including children trafficked from Nepal, working in circuses?
decisions.q_id: Wajibkah negara menyelamatkan anak, termasuk anak yang diperdagangkan dari Nepal, yang bekerja di sirkus?
decisions.held: Yes. Employing children in circuses was prohibited, raids and rescue were ordered, and the government had to act against trafficking.
decisions.plain: Children, many of them brought from Nepal, were found working and abused in Indian circuses. The Supreme Court banned child labour in circuses and ordered rescues and rehabilitation.
decisions.plain_id: Anak-anak, banyak yang dibawa dari Nepal, ditemukan bekerja dan dianiaya di sirkus India. MA melarang pekerja anak di sirkus dan memerintahkan penyelamatan dan rehabilitasi.

decisions.name: Vishal Jeet v. Union of India
decisions.q: What must the state do about girls trafficked into forced prostitution, including across borders?
decisions.q_id: Apa yang wajib dilakukan negara terhadap anak perempuan yang diperdagangkan untuk prostitusi paksa, termasuk lintas batas?
decisions.held: The state must take strict action under the trafficking law and set up advisory committees and rehabilitation schemes.
decisions.plain: A lawyer asked the Supreme Court to act on girls forced into prostitution, some brought from neighbouring countries. The court told governments to enforce the law and help the girls rebuild their lives.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang advokat meminta MA bertindak terhadap anak perempuan yang dipaksa melacur, sebagian dibawa dari negara tetangga. Pengadilan memerintahkan pemerintah menegakkan hukum dan membantu mereka membangun hidup kembali.

decisions.name: Writ on Bangladeshi workers who died on World Cup projects
decisions.court: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
decisions.q: Must the government list Bangladeshi workers who died or were injured on construction projects abroad, and consider compensation for families?
decisions.q_id: Wajibkah pemerintah mendata pekerja Bangladesh yang meninggal atau cedera di proyek konstruksi di luar negeri, dan mempertimbangkan ganti rugi bagi keluarga?
decisions.held: The court directed the ministries to compile the list within a month and asked them to show cause why compensation should not be ordered; the Appellate Division chamber judge stayed the list directive until March 2023.
decisions.plain: A lawyer asked Bangladesh’s High Court to make the government account for workers who died or were hurt building stadiums abroad. The court ordered a list and asked about compensation. A higher judge paused part of the order.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang advokat meminta Pengadilan Tinggi Bangladesh mewajibkan pemerintah mendata pekerja yang meninggal atau cedera saat membangun stadion di luar negeri. Pengadilan memerintahkan pendataan dan menanyakan ganti rugi. Hakim yang lebih tinggi menangguhkan sebagian perintah itu.

after.en: List ordered; rule issued on compensation.
after.id: Pendataan diperintahkan; perintah ganti rugi dipertanyakan.

after.en: Chamber judge stays the list directive until 6 March. [Later course to check.]
after.id: Hakim kamar menangguhkan perintah pendataan sampai 6 Maret. [Kelanjutannya perlu diperiksa.]

decisions.name: PERT/CPM Manpower Exponent Co. v. Vinuya
decisions.q: Were workers who resigned abroad after their contracts were changed for the worse illegally dismissed, and is the recruiter liable?
decisions.q_id: Apakah pekerja yang mengundurkan diri di luar negeri setelah kontraknya diubah merugikan dipecat secara tidak sah, dan apakah perekrut bertanggung jawab?
decisions.held: Yes. Substituting worse contracts amounted to constructive dismissal, and the recruitment agency was jointly liable for the workers’ money claims.
decisions.plain: Filipino workers sent abroad were made to sign new contracts with lower pay than promised, then quit and came home. The Supreme Court said they had effectively been dismissed and the agency had to pay.
decisions.plain_id: Pekerja Filipina yang dikirim ke luar negeri dipaksa menandatangani kontrak baru dengan upah lebih rendah dari yang dijanjikan, lalu berhenti dan pulang. MA menyatakan mereka pada dasarnya dipecat dan agen harus membayar.

decisions.name: Macalintal v. Commission on Elections (overseas absentee voting)
decisions.q: Can Filipinos working abroad vote in national elections without returning home?
decisions.q_id: Bisakah warga Filipina yang bekerja di luar negeri memilih dalam pemilu nasional tanpa pulang?
decisions.held: Yes. The Overseas Absentee Voting Act was largely upheld; Filipinos abroad keep their domicile at home for voting purposes. Some provisions giving Congress oversight of the election body were struck down.
decisions.plain: A lawyer challenged the new law letting Filipinos abroad vote. The Supreme Court upheld the right of overseas workers to vote from abroad.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang advokat menggugat UU baru yang membolehkan warga Filipina di luar negeri memilih. MA mempertahankan hak pekerja di luar negeri untuk memilih dari luar negeri.

after.id: Pemungutan suara pertama dari luar negeri.

decisions.name: Rafoneke v. Minister of Justice and Correctional Services
decisions.q: May qualified foreign lawyers, such as Lesotho nationals trained in South Africa, be barred from practising because they are not citizens or permanent residents?
decisions.q_id: Bolehkah pengacara asing yang berkualifikasi, seperti warga Lesotho yang dididik di Afrika Selatan, dilarang berpraktik karena bukan warga negara atau penduduk tetap?
decisions.held: Yes. Section 24(2) of the Legal Practice Act was held not to be unfair discrimination.
decisions.plain: Law graduates from Lesotho and Zimbabwe who studied in South Africa could not be admitted as lawyers because they were not citizens or permanent residents. The Constitutional Court let the rule stand.
decisions.plain_id: Lulusan hukum dari Lesotho dan Zimbabwe yang belajar di Afrika Selatan tidak bisa diangkat sebagai pengacara karena bukan warga negara atau penduduk tetap. MK mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.plain_id: Penduduk asing dikecualikan dari seleksi panitera pengadilan karena kewarganegaraan.

decisions.name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Provisional Measures, Order of 23 July 2018
decisions.plain: Interstate case under the race discrimination convention (ICERD). The Court ordered interim measures, including that families separated by measures based on nationality be reunited and that affected students and litigants keep access to education and courts. Part of a series with the CERD decisions of 2019 and the ICJ judgment of 2021.
decisions.plain_id: Perkara antarnegara berdasarkan Konvensi Penghapusan Diskriminasi Rasial (ICERD). Mahkamah memerintahkan tindakan sementara, antara lain agar keluarga yang terpisah akibat tindakan berdasarkan kewarganegaraan disatukan kembali, serta agar pelajar dan pihak berperkara tetap dapat mengakses pendidikan dan pengadilan.

decisions.name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Provisional Measures, Order of 14 June 2019
decisions.plain: The Court declined the respondent's request for provisional measures against the applicant. Procedural step in the same ICERD case.
decisions.plain_id: Mahkamah menolak permohonan tindakan sementara yang diajukan termohon terhadap pemohon. Langkah prosedural dalam perkara ICERD yang sama.

decisions.name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates, Decision on Jurisdiction (inter-state communication)
decisions.court: UN Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination
decisions.plain: The Committee held that it had jurisdiction over the inter-state communication and rejected the objection that distinctions based on current nationality fall outside the convention. Key question: does ICERD protect non-citizens against nationality-based measures? Compare the ICJ judgment of 2021, which read 'national origin' more narrowly.
decisions.plain_id: Komite menyatakan berwenang atas komunikasi antarnegara ini dan menolak keberatan bahwa pembedaan berdasarkan kewarganegaraan saat ini berada di luar cakupan konvensi. Bandingkan dengan putusan ICJ 2021 yang menafsirkan 'asal kebangsaan' secara lebih sempit.

decisions.name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates, Decision on Admissibility (inter-state communication)
decisions.court: UN Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination
decisions.plain: Companion decision on admissibility, addressing the objections on exhaustion of domestic remedies and on parallel proceedings before the ICJ. To be confirmed against the official text.
decisions.plain_id: Putusan pendamping tentang dapat diterimanya komunikasi, menyangkut keberatan soal upaya hukum domestik dan perkara paralel di ICJ. Perlu dicocokkan dengan teks resmi.

decisions.name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Preliminary Objections, Judgment of 4 February 2021
decisions.plain: The Court upheld a preliminary objection and found it lacked jurisdiction, holding that 'national origin' in ICERD does not include current nationality. Reads the convention differently from the CERD Committee's 2019 decision; a central text on how far ICERD protects non-citizens.
decisions.plain_id: Mahkamah menerima keberatan awal dan menyatakan tidak berwenang, dengan pertimbangan bahwa 'asal kebangsaan' dalam ICERD tidak mencakup kewarganegaraan saat ini. Tafsir ini berbeda dari putusan Komite CERD 2019.

decisions.name: Hammel v. Madagascar
decisions.plain: Expulsion of a foreign lawyer without a chance to contest the order; the Committee read article 13 ICCPR as requiring that an alien lawfully present may be expelled only by a decision reached in accordance with law.
decisions.plain_id: Pengusiran seorang advokat asing tanpa kesempatan menggugat perintah pengusiran; Komite menafsirkan Pasal 13 ICCPR bahwa orang asing yang berada secara sah hanya dapat diusir melalui keputusan yang sesuai hukum.

src.t: University of Minnesota Human Rights Library

decisions.name: Giry v. Dominican Republic
decisions.plain: A foreign national was removed without any administrative or judicial process; the Committee treated the removal as expulsion under article 13, whatever its label (extradition or expulsion).
decisions.plain_id: Seorang warga asing dipindahkan tanpa proses administratif atau peradilan apa pun; Komite memperlakukannya sebagai pengusiran menurut Pasal 13, apa pun sebutannya.

src.t: University of Minnesota Human Rights Library

decisions.name: Maksudov, Rakhimov, Tashbaev and Pirmatov v. Kyrgyzstan
decisions.plain: Extradition of Uzbek asylum seekers despite risk of torture; issues of non-refoulement, diplomatic assurances and detention. Findings to be confirmed against the full text.
decisions.plain_id: Ekstradisi pencari suaka asal Uzbekistan meskipun ada risiko penyiksaan; isu non-refoulement, jaminan diplomatik dan penahanan. Temuan perlu dicocokkan dengan teks lengkap.

decisions.name: Ilyasov v. Kazakhstan
decisions.plain: Entry ban on a foreign national that kept him from his family in Kazakhstan; family life (articles 17 and 23). The State later reported that the ban had been lifted. Findings to be confirmed against the full text.
decisions.plain_id: Larangan masuk terhadap warga asing yang memisahkannya dari keluarganya di Kazakhstan; hak atas kehidupan keluarga (Pasal 17 dan 23). Negara kemudian melaporkan larangan itu dicabut.

src.t: University of Minnesota Human Rights Library

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion OC-4/84 (proposed amendments to the naturalization provisions of the Constitution of Costa Rica)
decisions.plain: Whether stricter naturalization rules for some foreigners, and different rules for foreign wives and husbands, are compatible with equality before the law. The Court accepted some distinctions as reasonable but found the sex-based difference discriminatory.
decisions.plain_id: Apakah aturan naturalisasi yang lebih ketat bagi sebagian orang asing, dan aturan yang berbeda bagi istri dan suami asing, sesuai dengan persamaan di depan hukum. Mahkamah menerima sebagian pembedaan sebagai wajar, tetapi menilai pembedaan berdasarkan jenis kelamin diskriminatif.

src.t: Inter-American Court of Human Rights (front page)

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion OC-27/21 (freedom of association, collective bargaining and the right to strike, with a gender perspective)
decisions.cite: OC-27/21, requested by the Inter-American Commission
decisions.plain: Scope of union freedom, collective bargaining and the right to strike, and their link to equality for women workers. Relevant to migrant workers, who are often excluded from union rights in law or practice. Details to be confirmed against the text.
decisions.plain_id: Cakupan kebebasan berserikat, perundingan bersama dan hak mogok, serta kaitannya dengan kesetaraan bagi pekerja perempuan. Relevan bagi pekerja migran, yang sering dikecualikan dari hak berserikat dalam hukum atau praktik.

src.t: Inter-American Court of Human Rights (front page)

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion OC-31/25 (content and scope of the right to care)
decisions.plain: Recognizes care as an autonomous right, covering the right to be cared for, to care and to self-care, and the labor rights of paid care workers. Relevant to migrant domestic and care workers. Date and details to be confirmed against the text.
decisions.plain_id: Mengakui perawatan sebagai hak yang berdiri sendiri, mencakup hak untuk dirawat, merawat, dan merawat diri, serta hak-hak pekerja perawatan berbayar. Relevan bagi pekerja rumah tangga dan pekerja perawatan migran.

src.t: Inter-American Court of Human Rights (front page)

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion OC-32/25 (climate emergency and human rights)
decisions.cite: OC-32/25, requested by Chile and Colombia
decisions.plain: State duties in the climate emergency, including protection of people displaced or moving because of climate impacts. Date and the passages on human mobility to be confirmed against the text.
decisions.plain_id: Kewajiban negara dalam darurat iklim, termasuk perlindungan bagi orang yang mengungsi atau berpindah akibat dampak iklim.

src.t: Inter-American Court of Human Rights (front page)

decisions.name: Advisory Opinion on the compatibility of vagrancy laws with the African Charter and other human rights instruments (No. 001/2018)
decisions.court: African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights
decisions.cite: Request No. 001/2018, requested by the Pan African Lawyers Union; opinion of 4 December 2020
decisions.plain: Found that vagrancy laws punishing people for being poor, homeless or without visible means of support, including summary arrest and forced relocation, are incompatible with the African Charter. Such laws often fall on migrants and informal workers. Details to be confirmed against the text.
decisions.plain_id: Menyatakan bahwa undang-undang gelandangan yang menghukum orang karena miskin, tunawisma, atau tanpa mata pencaharian yang jelas, termasuk penangkapan seketika dan pemindahan paksa, bertentangan dengan Piagam Afrika. Aturan semacam ini kerap mengenai migran dan pekerja informal.

decisions.name: Obligations of States in respect of Climate Change (Advisory Opinion)
decisions.cite: Advisory Opinion of 23 July 2025, requested by the UN General Assembly (GL No. 187)
decisions.plain: States’ obligations under international law to protect the climate system, read together with human rights law. Included for its relevance to climate-related displacement and migration; the relevant passages are to be confirmed against the text.
decisions.plain_id: Kewajiban negara menurut hukum internasional untuk melindungi sistem iklim, dibaca bersama hukum HAM. Dimasukkan karena relevan dengan pengungsian dan migrasi terkait iklim.

decisions.name: The Haitian Centre for Human Rights et al. v. United States
decisions.plain: Interdiction of Haitian boats on the high seas and summary return of the people on board to Haiti. The Commission found that the American Declaration applied to conduct at sea and that the returns breached the rights to life, liberty and security, equality, asylum and judicial protection. Key text on extraterritorial obligations and non-refoulement at sea; compare Hirsi Jamaa v. Italy (ECtHR 2012). Details to be confirmed against the report.
decisions.plain_id: Pencegatan kapal warga Haiti di laut lepas dan pemulangan seketika penumpangnya ke Haiti. Komisi menyatakan bahwa Deklarasi Amerika berlaku atas tindakan di laut dan bahwa pemulangan itu melanggar hak atas hidup, kebebasan dan keamanan, persamaan, suaka, serta perlindungan hukum. Bandingkan dengan Hirsi Jamaa v. Italia (ECtHR 2012).

decisions.name: Asylum Case (Colombia v. Peru), Judgment of 20 November 1950
decisions.plain: Colombia granted diplomatic asylum in its Lima embassy to the Peruvian politician Victor Raúl Haya de la Torre. The Court held that Colombia could not unilaterally qualify the offence as political in a way binding on Peru, that Peru was not obliged to give safe conduct out of the country, and that the asylum did not meet the urgency requirement of the 1928 Havana Convention. Also a leading case on proving a regional custom (Latin American practice of asylum).
decisions.plain_id: Kolombia memberikan suaka diplomatik di kedutaannya di Lima kepada politisi Peru Victor Raúl Haya de la Torre. Mahkamah memutuskan bahwa Kolombia tidak dapat secara sepihak menetapkan sifat politis kejahatan itu secara mengikat bagi Peru, bahwa Peru tidak wajib memberi jaminan jalan keluar, dan bahwa suaka itu tidak memenuhi syarat keadaan mendesak dalam Konvensi Havana 1928. Juga perkara penting tentang pembuktian kebiasaan regional.

decisions.name: Haya de la Torre Case (Colombia v. Peru), Judgment of 13 June 1951
decisions.plain: Follow-up to the Asylum Case. The Court held that Colombia was not obliged to surrender Haya de la Torre to the Peruvian authorities, but that the asylum, granted irregularly, should be brought to an end; it left the way of ending it to the parties. Shows the limits of judicial settlement in asylum disputes.
decisions.plain_id: Lanjutan Perkara Suaka. Mahkamah memutuskan bahwa Kolombia tidak wajib menyerahkan Haya de la Torre kepada otoritas Peru, tetapi suaka yang diberikan tidak sesuai aturan itu harus diakhiri; cara mengakhirinya diserahkan kepada para pihak.

decisions.name: Nottebohm Case (Liechtenstein v. Guatemala), Second Phase, Judgment of 6 April 1955
decisions.plain: A German-born merchant who had lived in Guatemala for decades acquired Liechtenstein nationality shortly before being interned and expelled by Guatemala during the Second World War. The Court held the claim inadmissible: Guatemala need not recognize a nationality without a genuine connection, so Liechtenstein could not exercise diplomatic protection. Leading case on nationality and the protection of long-term foreign residents.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang pedagang kelahiran Jerman yang puluhan tahun tinggal di Guatemala memperoleh kewarganegaraan Liechtenstein tak lama sebelum diinternir dan diusir oleh Guatemala pada Perang Dunia II. Mahkamah menyatakan gugatan tidak dapat diterima: Guatemala tidak wajib mengakui kewarganegaraan tanpa hubungan yang sungguh-sungguh, sehingga Liechtenstein tidak dapat memberikan perlindungan diplomatik.

decisions.name: Nationality Decrees Issued in Tunis and Morocco (Advisory Opinion)
decisions.plain: Dispute between France and the United Kingdom over French decrees conferring nationality on persons born in the protectorates of Tunis and Morocco, including children of British subjects. The Court held that the matter was not solely within French domestic jurisdiction, because whether a question is domestic depends on the development of international relations and on treaty obligations. Foundational text on the limits of state discretion over nationality.
decisions.plain_id: Sengketa antara Prancis dan Inggris tentang dekrit Prancis yang memberikan kewarganegaraan kepada orang yang lahir di protektorat Tunis dan Maroko, termasuk anak-anak warga Inggris. Mahkamah menyatakan bahwa persoalan itu bukan semata urusan dalam negeri Prancis, karena hal itu bergantung pada perkembangan hubungan internasional dan kewajiban perjanjian.

decisions.name: Case C-34/09 Gerardo Ruiz Zambrano v Office national de l’emploi
decisions.court: Court of Justice of the European Union
decisions.plain: Colombian parents of Belgian citizen children were refused residence and a work permit. The Court held that EU citizenship precludes measures that deprive citizen children of the genuine enjoyment of their rights, so the parents had to be allowed to reside and work. Comparator.
decisions.plain_id: Orang tua asal Kolombia dari anak-anak berkewarganegaraan Belgia ditolak izin tinggal dan izin kerjanya. Mahkamah menyatakan bahwa kewarganegaraan Uni Eropa melarang tindakan yang menghilangkan penikmatan hak anak-anak warga negara, sehingga orang tua harus diizinkan tinggal dan bekerja. Pembanding.

decisions.name: Kleindienst v. Mandel
decisions.court: Supreme Court of the United States
decisions.plain: A Belgian Marxist scholar was refused a visa to speak in the United States. The Court upheld the refusal, holding that courts will not look behind a facially legitimate and bona fide reason given by the executive for excluding a non-citizen. Comparator on judicial deference in admission decisions.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang akademisi Marxis asal Belgia ditolak visanya untuk berceramah di Amerika Serikat. Mahkamah menguatkan penolakan itu: pengadilan tidak akan menguji lebih jauh alasan eksekutif yang secara lahiriah sah dan beritikad baik untuk menolak orang asing. Pembanding.

decisions.name: Aristimuño Mendizabal v. France
decisions.plain: A Spanish national lawfully living in France was kept for some fourteen years on short temporary residence receipts. The Court found that the prolonged insecurity of her status breached her right to private and family life (Art. 8). Comparator on precarious residence.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang warga Spanyol yang tinggal secara sah di Prancis selama sekitar empat belas tahun hanya diberi tanda terima izin tinggal sementara berjangka pendek. Mahkamah menilai ketidakpastian status yang berkepanjangan itu melanggar hak atas kehidupan pribadi dan keluarga (Pasal 8). Pembanding.

decisions.name: M.K. and Others v. Poland
decisions.plain: Chechen families were repeatedly turned away at the Polish–Belarusian border without their asylum claims being received. The Court found breaches of the prohibition of ill-treatment and refoulement (Art. 3), of collective expulsion (Protocol 4, Art. 4) and of the duty to comply with interim measures. Comparator on access to asylum at land borders.
decisions.plain_id: Keluarga-keluarga Chechnya berulang kali ditolak di perbatasan Polandia–Belarus tanpa permohonan suaka mereka diterima. Mahkamah menyatakan pelanggaran larangan perlakuan buruk dan refoulement (Pasal 3), larangan pengusiran kolektif (Protokol 4 Pasal 4), dan kewajiban mematuhi tindakan sementara. Pembanding.

decisions.name: M.N. and Others v. Belgium (Grand Chamber decision)
decisions.plain: A Syrian family applied for humanitarian visas at the Belgian embassy in Beirut. The Grand Chamber held that the visa procedure did not bring them within Belgium’s jurisdiction, so the Convention did not apply and the application was inadmissible. Comparator on the limits of extraterritorial obligations in admission.
decisions.plain_id: Sebuah keluarga Suriah mengajukan visa kemanusiaan di Kedutaan Belgia di Beirut. Majelis Agung menyatakan bahwa prosedur visa itu tidak membawa mereka ke dalam yurisdiksi Belgia, sehingga Konvensi tidak berlaku dan permohonan tidak dapat diterima. Pembanding.

decisions.name: Khan v. France
decisions.plain: An unaccompanied Afghan child lived for months in the Calais camp without the protective care ordered by a French judge. The Court found degrading treatment (Art. 3) because the authorities failed to provide care. Comparator on unaccompanied migrant children.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang anak Afghanistan tanpa pendamping tinggal berbulan-bulan di kamp Calais tanpa pengasuhan yang diperintahkan hakim Prancis. Mahkamah menyatakan terjadi perlakuan merendahkan martabat (Pasal 3) karena otoritas gagal memberikan pengasuhan. Pembanding.

decisions.name: Aumeeruddy-Cziffra and 19 other Mauritian women v. Mauritius
decisions.plain: Mauritian laws let foreign wives of Mauritian men reside freely but made foreign husbands of Mauritian women subject to residence permits and deportation. The Committee found sex discrimination in the protection of the family (articles 2(1), 3, 17, 23 and 26 ICCPR). Early leading view on family life and residence of non-citizen spouses.
decisions.plain_id: Undang-undang Mauritius membolehkan istri asing warga Mauritius tinggal bebas, tetapi suami asing perempuan Mauritius harus memiliki izin tinggal dan dapat dideportasi. Komite menyatakan adanya diskriminasi jenis kelamin dalam perlindungan keluarga (Pasal 2(1), 3, 17, 23 dan 26 ICCPR).

decisions.name: Núñez Chipana v. Venezuela
decisions.plain: Venezuela extradited a Peruvian woman to Peru despite a substantial risk of torture, and despite the Committee's request for interim measures. The Committee found a breach of the non-refoulement obligation in article 3 CAT.
decisions.plain_id: Venezuela mengekstradisi seorang perempuan Peru ke Peru meskipun ada risiko nyata penyiksaan dan permintaan tindakan sementara dari Komite. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran kewajiban non-refoulement dalam Pasal 3 CAT.

decisions.name: Pelit v. Azerbaijan
decisions.plain: A Turkish national of Kurdish origin, recognized as a refugee in Germany, was extradited from Azerbaijan to Turkey in spite of the Committee's request for interim measures. The Committee found breaches of articles 3 and 22 CAT; diplomatic assurances did not cure the risk.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang warga Turki keturunan Kurdi yang diakui sebagai pengungsi di Jerman diekstradisi dari Azerbaijan ke Turki meskipun Komite telah meminta tindakan sementara. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran Pasal 3 dan 22 CAT; jaminan diplomatik tidak menghapus risiko.

decisions.name: Abdussamatov and Others v. Kazakhstan
decisions.plain: Twenty-nine Uzbek asylum seekers were extradited from Kazakhstan to Uzbekistan. The Committee found breaches of articles 3 and 22 CAT and held that an examination under the Refugee Convention alone did not satisfy the absolute non-refoulement obligation under CAT.
decisions.plain_id: Dua puluh sembilan pencari suaka asal Uzbekistan diekstradisi dari Kazakhstan ke Uzbekistan. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran Pasal 3 dan 22 CAT dan bahwa pemeriksaan menurut Konvensi Pengungsi saja tidak memenuhi kewajiban non-refoulement yang mutlak menurut CAT.

decisions.name: Raghda Habal and son v. Argentina
decisions.plain: A Syrian-born woman was summarily expelled from Argentina after her naturalization was annulled. The Commission held that due process guarantees (American Convention arts. 8 and 25) apply to expulsion proceedings, and found violations. Details to be confirmed against the report.
decisions.plain_id: Seorang perempuan kelahiran Suriah diusir secara seketika dari Argentina setelah naturalisasinya dibatalkan. Komisi menyatakan bahwa jaminan proses hukum (Pasal 8 dan 25 Konvensi Amerika) berlaku dalam proses pengusiran, dan menemukan pelanggaran.

decisions.name: Loren Laroye Riebe Star, Jorge Barón Guttlein and Rodolfo Izal Elorz v. Mexico
decisions.plain: Three foreign priests working in Chiapas were detained and expelled in 1995 without a chance to defend themselves. The Commission held that a minimum of due process applies to expulsion and found violations of the rights to personal liberty, fair trial and judicial protection.
decisions.plain_id: Tiga pastor asing yang bekerja di Chiapas ditahan dan diusir pada 1995 tanpa kesempatan membela diri. Komisi menyatakan bahwa proses hukum minimum berlaku dalam pengusiran dan menemukan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan, peradilan yang adil dan perlindungan hukum.

decisions.name: John Doe et al. v. Canada
decisions.plain: Asylum seekers arriving from the United States were 'directed back' there to wait for their hearings and some were then removed by the United States. The Commission held that a state may not return a claimant to a third country whose law bars their asylum claim without an individual assessment. Comparator (North America).
decisions.plain_id: Pencari suaka yang datang dari Amerika Serikat 'dikembalikan' ke sana untuk menunggu sidang, dan sebagian kemudian dipulangkan oleh AS. Komisi menyatakan negara tidak boleh mengembalikan pemohon ke negara ketiga yang hukumnya menghalangi permohonan suakanya tanpa penilaian individual. Pembanding.

decisions.name: Rafael Ferrer-Mazorra et al. v. United States
decisions.plain: Cuban nationals who arrived in the 1980 Mariel boatlift were held for years in immigration detention. The Commission found violations of the rights to liberty and to protection from arbitrary arrest under the American Declaration. Comparator on prolonged immigration detention.
decisions.plain_id: Warga Kuba yang tiba lewat eksodus perahu Mariel 1980 ditahan bertahun-tahun dalam penahanan imigrasi. Komisi menyatakan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan dan perlindungan dari penangkapan sewenang-wenang menurut Deklarasi Amerika. Pembanding.
