args.en: Labour rights apply whatever a worker’s immigration status
args.id: Hak pekerja berlaku apa pun status imigrasinya

args.en: Treating migrant workers worse than others breaches equality
args.id: Memperlakukan pekerja migran lebih buruk melanggar kesetaraan

args.en: Tying a worker to one employer breaches liberty or freedom of occupation
args.id: Mengikat pekerja pada satu majikan melanggar kebebasan

args.en: The state must make forced labour and servitude crimes and enforce them
args.id: Negara wajib menjadikan kerja paksa dan perhambaan tindak pidana dan menegakkannya

args.en: The state must investigate trafficking and protect possible victims
args.id: Negara wajib menyelidiki perdagangan orang dan melindungi calon korban

args.en: Illegal working does not bar a claim against an abusive employer
args.id: Bekerja secara ilegal tidak menghalangi gugatan terhadap majikan yang menyalahgunakan

args.en: The recruiter at home is liable together with the employer abroad
args.id: Agen perekrut di dalam negeri ikut bertanggung jawab bersama majikan di luar negeri

args.en: A rule struck down as unconstitutional cannot simply be re-enacted
args.id: Aturan yang sudah dibatalkan tidak bisa begitu saja dibuat lagi

args.en: Protection laws must keep covering seafarers and fishers
args.id: UU pelindungan harus tetap mencakup awak kapal dan pelaut perikanan

args.en: The state must secure food and registration for migrant workers in a crisis
args.id: Negara wajib menjamin pangan dan pendataan pekerja migran saat krisis

args.en: A compulsory live-in rule is unlawful
args.id: Aturan wajib tinggal bersama majikan tidak sah

args.en: Discrimination because of immigration status is race or nationality discrimination
args.id: Diskriminasi karena status imigrasi adalah diskriminasi ras atau kewarganegaraan

args.en: Arrested foreign nationals must be told they can contact their consulate
args.id: Warga asing yang ditangkap wajib diberi tahu hak menghubungi konsulat

args.en: Irregular entry or stay must not be punished with prison
args.id: Masuk atau tinggal tanpa dokumen tidak boleh dihukum penjara

args.en: Migrants may not be expelled as a group without individual review
args.id: Migran tidak boleh diusir berkelompok tanpa pemeriksaan perorangan

args.en: Children born in the country must not be left stateless because of their parents’ status
args.id: Anak yang lahir di negara itu tidak boleh dibiarkan tanpa kewarganegaraan karena status orang tuanya

args.en: Migrants are entitled at least to emergency health care
args.id: Migran berhak setidaknya atas layanan kesehatan darurat

args.en: Restricting women’s migration breaches equality
args.id: Membatasi migrasi perempuan melanggar kesetaraan

args.en: Accusations made after a dispute with the employer must be examined for motive
args.id: Tuduhan yang muncul setelah sengketa dengan majikan harus diperiksa motifnya

args.en: Immigration detention must have a time limit and prompt review by a court
args.id: Penahanan imigrasi harus punya batas waktu dan segera ditinjau pengadilan

args.en: A worker’s lawful speech or activism must not cost them their stay or freedom
args.id: Pendapat atau kegiatan sah pekerja tidak boleh membuatnya kehilangan izin tinggal atau kebebasan

args.en: People waiting for protection decisions have a right to work
args.id: Orang yang menunggu keputusan perlindungan berhak bekerja

args.en: Migrant parents may stay to care for children who are residents
args.id: Orang tua migran boleh tinggal untuk merawat anak yang berstatus penduduk

args.en: Pregnancy or childbirth must not cost a migrant worker her job or permit
args.id: Kehamilan atau persalinan tidak boleh membuat pekerja migran kehilangan pekerjaan atau izin

args.en: Working-time limits and overtime apply to live-in care work
args.id: Batas jam kerja dan lembur berlaku bagi pekerja perawatan yang tinggal di rumah majikan

args.en: Wages may not be withheld to push workers to leave
args.id: Upah tidak boleh ditahan untuk mendorong pekerja pergi

args.en: The state may set minimum terms for domestic workers’ contracts
args.id: Negara boleh menetapkan syarat minimum kontrak pekerja rumah tangga

args.en: Fundamental rights protect non-citizens, not only citizens
args.id: Hak dasar melindungi bukan warga negara, tidak hanya warga negara

args.en: No one may be sent back to a place where they face serious harm
args.id: Tidak seorang pun boleh dipulangkan ke tempat ia menghadapi bahaya serius

args.en: Excluding domestic workers from labour protection is discrimination
args.id: Mengecualikan pekerja rumah tangga dari perlindungan kerja adalah diskriminasi

args.en: Random migration checks breach freedom of movement and lead to profiling
args.id: Pemeriksaan imigrasi acak melanggar kebebasan bergerak dan memicu profil rasial

args.en: The state must prove that a person is a foreigner before treating them as one
args.id: Negara wajib membuktikan seseorang orang asing sebelum memperlakukannya demikian

args.en: Trafficked people must not be punished for offences they were forced to commit
args.id: Korban perdagangan orang tidak boleh dihukum atas pelanggaran yang dipaksakan kepada mereka

args.en: Migrant workers abroad keep the right to vote at home
args.id: Pekerja migran di luar negeri tetap berhak memilih di negaranya

tools.id: Melihat ke depan: insentif ke depan
tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 1, Ex ante and ex post
tools.def: The court asks what its ruling will encourage or deter in future, for example whether denying a claim would reward employers who hire workers without papers.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menimbang apa yang akan didorong atau dicegah putusannya di masa depan, misalnya apakah menolak gugatan justru menguntungkan majikan yang mempekerjakan pekerja tanpa dokumen.

tools.en: Purpose and policy of the rule
tools.ch: Neumann, Margolis and Stanchi, Legal Reasoning and Legal Writing, on policy arguments
tools.def: The court reasons from what the rule is for, such as protecting workers who cannot bargain on equal terms, and asks which result serves that purpose.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan bernalar dari untuk apa aturan itu dibuat, seperti melindungi pekerja yang tidak dapat berunding secara setara, dan menimbang hasil mana yang memenuhi tujuan itu.

tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 5, The least cost avoider
tools.def: Responsibility is placed on the party best able to prevent the harm at the lowest cost, such as the recruiter, the employer or the state.
tools.def_id: Tanggung jawab dibebankan kepada pihak yang paling mampu mencegah kerugian dengan biaya terendah, seperti perekrut, majikan atau negara.

tools.def: The court deals with someone acting for another, such as a recruitment agency acting for a foreign employer, and with who answers for the agent's conduct.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menangani pihak yang bertindak untuk pihak lain, seperti agen perekrutan yang bertindak untuk majikan asing, dan siapa yang bertanggung jawab atas perbuatan agen itu.

tools.def: The court lays down or applies a fixed, easily checked rule, such as a time limit on detention or a category that is always covered.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menetapkan atau menerapkan aturan yang pasti dan mudah diperiksa, seperti batas waktu penahanan atau golongan yang selalu dilindungi.

tools.def: The court calls for an individual assessment of the facts, such as reasonableness, proportionality or a person's own circumstances, instead of a blanket rule.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan meminta penilaian fakta secara individual, seperti kewajaran, proporsionalitas atau keadaan orang itu sendiri, bukan aturan pukul rata.

tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 18, Slippery slopes; Schlag and Skover pt 2 (parade of horribles)
tools.def: One side argues that accepting a claim would lead step by step to wider results; the court accepts or answers the argument.
tools.def_id: Salah satu pihak berargumen bahwa menerima gugatan akan berujung selangkah demi selangkah pada akibat yang lebih luas; pengadilan menerima atau menjawab argumen itu.

tools.ch: Schlag and Skover pt 2; Schauer ch. 5, Analogies
tools.def: The court treats the case as like, or unlike, another situation, for example likening tied employment to servitude or migrant workers to citizen workers, and the other side may call the analogy false.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan memperlakukan perkara sebagai serupa, atau tidak serupa, dengan keadaan lain, misalnya menyamakan kerja yang terikat dengan perhambaan atau pekerja migran dengan pekerja warga negara, dan pihak lain dapat menyebut analogi itu keliru.

tools.ch: Schlag and Skover pt 2, Attacks on levels of abstraction
tools.def: The result depends on how broadly the right or the question is framed: as a general guarantee to every person, or narrowly as a claim by one group in one setting.
tools.def_id: Hasil perkara bergantung pada seberapa luas hak atau pertanyaannya dirumuskan: sebagai jaminan umum bagi setiap orang, atau secara sempit sebagai tuntutan satu kelompok dalam satu keadaan.

tools.en: Kind of remedy: stop the act or pay for it
tools.id: Jenis pemulihan: hentikan perbuatan atau bayar ganti rugi
tools.ch: Farnsworth ch. 20, Property rules and liability rules
tools.def: The court chooses between protecting the right outright (release, reinstatement, a ban on removal) and letting it be taken against payment (damages, back pay).
tools.def_id: Pengadilan memilih antara melindungi hak secara langsung (pembebasan, pemulihan kerja, larangan pengusiran) dan membolehkan hak diambil dengan pembayaran (ganti rugi, upah tertunggak).

tools.def: The case turns on the point of comparison: whether migrant workers are measured against citizens, against other workers, or against no protection at all.
tools.def_id: Perkara bergantung pada titik pembanding: apakah pekerja migran diukur terhadap warga negara, terhadap pekerja lain, atau terhadap tiadanya perlindungan sama sekali.

tools.en: Procedure: who may decide, and when
tools.id: Prosedur: siapa yang berwenang, dan kapan
tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 3, Arguing in a legal system: procedure
tools.def: The case turns on jurisdiction, standing, admissibility, time limits or exhaustion of remedies, rather than on the merits alone.
tools.def_id: Perkara bergantung pada kewenangan mengadili, kedudukan hukum, dapat diterimanya permohonan, tenggat waktu atau upaya hukum yang harus ditempuh lebih dulu, bukan hanya pada pokok perkara.

tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 4; Giltrow and others (eds), Legal Meanings; Brewer (ed.) 1998 (Frankfurter, Llewellyn, Miller); Sankari 2013 ch. 3 (wording, scheme, spirit)
tools.def: The court settles what the words of a statute, constitution, treaty or contract mean, by their wording, their purpose or their place in the whole instrument, or fills a gap the text left open.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan menentukan arti kata-kata undang-undang, konstitusi, perjanjian internasional atau kontrak, menurut bunyi, tujuan atau kedudukannya dalam keseluruhan instrumen, atau mengisi celah yang dibiarkan teks.

tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 5; Schauer ch. 3; Brewer (ed.) 1998 (Goodhart on the ratio decidendi); Sankari 2013 ch. 4 (lines of cases)
tools.def: The court relies on, extends, distinguishes or departs from earlier decisions, its own or those of other courts and treaty bodies.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan bersandar pada, memperluas, membedakan atau meninggalkan putusan terdahulu, baik putusannya sendiri maupun putusan pengadilan dan badan traktat lain.

tools.def: A national court relies on treaties, the views of treaty bodies, or judgments of foreign, regional or international courts, whether as binding law or as persuasive support.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan nasional bersandar pada perjanjian internasional, pandangan badan traktat, atau putusan pengadilan asing, regional atau internasional, baik sebagai hukum yang mengikat maupun sebagai dukungan yang meyakinkan.

tools.ch: Trachtman ch. 8, Arguing about substantive responsibility
tools.def: The court looks past the label or formal arrangement, such as a signed contract, a worker's apparent consent or a scheme's name, to what actually happened.
tools.def_id: Pengadilan melihat melampaui label atau susunan formal, seperti kontrak yang ditandatangani, persetujuan pekerja yang tampak atau nama suatu skema, kepada apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.

tools.ch: Farnsworth chs 27–28; Trachtman ch. 6, Arguing about facts
tools.def: The outcome depends on who must prove what, and how surely: for example the state proving that someone is a foreigner, or a presumption that a trafficked person acted under compulsion.
tools.def_id: Hasil perkara bergantung pada siapa yang harus membuktikan apa, dan seberapa pasti: misalnya negara membuktikan bahwa seseorang adalah orang asing, atau praduga bahwa korban perdagangan orang bertindak karena terpaksa.

codebook.def: Stable identifier of the decision entry
Case name as commonly cited
Court or body that decided
national = a domestic court; regional = a regional human rights court; international = a global court or treaty body
For national courts: destination = the country where the migrant worked; origin = the worker’s own country. Regional and international bodies are coded as such
Place of the court in its hierarchy
codebook.vals: apex | appeal | first | regional | advisory | international

codebook.def: ISO 3166 code of the state whose law or conduct was at issue
Region of that state, used for ordering (Asia, Africa, the Middle East and Latin America first)
codebook.vals: asia | africa | mideast | gulf | latam | pacific | europe | americas | intl (pacific includes Australia and New Zealand)

codebook.def: Date of the decision (YYYY-MM-DD; a year alone where the day is not yet confirmed)
Docket or report citation
Sector of work involved
Legal issues, semicolon separated
Visitor-facing situations the decision speaks to
Stage of the migration journey where the problem arose: 1 recruitment, 2 leaving, 3 working abroad, 4 changing or losing the job, 5 return and after

Type of case: criminal = prosecution of a person; private = dispute between private parties (labor, contract, tort), including claims against recruitment agencies and employers; administrative = challenge to a decision or practice of a government agency (immigration, labor, welfare) on ordinary legal grounds; constitutional = constitutional review, fundamental-rights petitions, and complaints to regional or international human rights bodies. Coded by rule from the court, the parties and the arguments, then corrected by hand; to be confirmed by researchers
Result for the worker or migrant side
codebook.vals: won | lost | advisory | unknown (candidates not yet checked)

codebook.def: What happened after the decision: carried = remedy or reform carried out; partly; not = not carried out; unknown = not yet established; none = nothing to carry out (worker lost, advisory, or law kept as it was)
Argument codes made for the worker side with 1 = accepted, 0 = rejected (see arguments.csv)

Reasoning tools (after Farnsworth, The Legal Analyst, 2007): exante | lca | agency | rule | standard | slope | remedy | baseline | proof; see reasoning-tools.csv. Coded by rule from the argument codes and the wording of the question and holding (AI-assisted), full entries only; to be confirmed against the judgment

C = unchecked candidate: name, court, year and topic only, shown with a mark, to be confirmed or removed; S = full entry coded from secondary sources and summaries, pending a line-by-line check against the judgment; P = checked against the judgment
